menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You may not like that she's with a guy, but the fact that Cameron's with her gives her a better chance out there.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It gives both of them a better chance.
Coach Kessler glares at Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Do you think I want to hear about how she's with some `boy` right now?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you think I want to hear about how she's with some [color=#e23b3b][i]boy[/i][/color] right now?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Do you have any idea, Hannah, what it's like to be in my shoes?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: No, sir.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Then sit there and be quiet.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You're right... She does.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I used to take her and Sara camping... I taught them how to survive out here.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You did a good job, sir. Emily's going to be all right.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: She could always start a fire faster than her sister or I could.
A booming thunder shakes Coach Kessler from the moment. He holds his hand out, feeling the rain come pouring down.
His face fills with a steely resolve...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Why didn't you stick with her? Why didn't any of you stick with her?
Coach hangs his head for a moment...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: She's so vulnerable.
The swimmers share sad glances with each other...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Coach, I know you're really `really` upset... But, you're forgetting...
nodes.text_bbcode: Coach, I know you're really [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] upset... But, you're forgetting...

options.label: She's got a good head on her shoulders.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: She said that we should just go on ahead without her.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: She was falling back?! My daughter doesn't just fall back unless she has a very good reason to do so!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Why was she back there?!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Uh... I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I told you not to lie to me, Hannah!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hey! Relax, Coach K! Ease off her.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Don't tell me how to act, Zach. Not when it's `my` daughter in danger.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't tell me how to act, Zach. Not when it's [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] daughter in danger.

nodes.text: Coach Kessler turns back to Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: If you won't tell the truth, it means you're somehow responsible.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And if she's hurt in anyway, Hannah, I swear... If she's hurt...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: She was talking to Cameron!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That sounds more like the truth... At least one of you has integrity.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: They were, um, flirting together! You know, her elbows were waaaay out like--
Coach isn't listening...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Cameron...
He turns from Hannah and Jane...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Was he flirting with her? Was he trying to make a move on her?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I... I think he might have been.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: It, uh... It looked like it to me. His elbows were pointing way out like--

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ahem.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Never mind. Lots of flirting.
Coach Kessler's fists clench tight.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Cameron.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Phew...
Emily crouches down and crawls into the space next to Cameron...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm surprised... I thought you'd put up more of a fuss...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Having to be so close to a notorious player like me.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I know you're not going to do anything.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Why's that?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Because somewhere out there is my dad...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Oh yeah... He must be--

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Stark-raving mad?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I was going to say 'upset'. But yours is probably more accurate.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I hope I'm wrong, though. I don't want him to be so worried about me.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And I definitely don't want him taking his anger out on everyone else...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but I'm not going to go in there next to `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sorry, but I'm not going to go in there next to [color=#3b78e2][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You think that I'm trying to make a move on you? I didn't design this cave. I can't help that it's this small.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, let's just go find another cave then.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: `You` can go find another cave. I'm staying right here at the Rocky Cave Inn.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You[/i][/color] can go find another cave. I'm staying right here at the Rocky Cave Inn.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Fine! Maybe I will.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm serious, Em. I'm not leaving here to go with you.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You're bluffing! You wouldn't let me go off all by myself! Not out here... Not while it's getting dark!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Try me.
Emily stops to consider Cameron's sincerity for a moment. In that pause, he flashes her a wide smile.
It's enough for Emily to stick to her guns.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Bye!
She turns from him and storms away, not even bothering to look back.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Em? Where are you going? It's dangerous.
As darkness begins to fall, Emily's anger wanes and is replaced with a feeling of complete loneliness.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Why did I have to be so stubborn?
After a few more steps, she stops.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I guess I'll swallow my pride and go back to Cameron's cave...
But when Emily turns around, she has no idea where she came from...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh no...
It's not clear whether Emily will make it back to Cameron, but one thing's for sure...
Emily moves rapidly along the ledge...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Em, slow down!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm fine. I've got this under--
Emily's foot slips!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Aaah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Aaah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Like lightning, Cameron darts his hand out, holding Emily up.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Be careful!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Sorry doesn't matter when you're gone.
Emily slows her pace, eventually making it to the other side.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hey, Emily, you okay?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm fine, I'm just... Still rattled by what happened back there...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Any sign of the rest of the swim team?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: No, and it's getting dark fast... We're going to have to spend the night here.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Wow. The cave is a lot smaller than I thought it would be. I don't think both of us can fit in that small space...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I know it's not a palace, but it's all we've got.
Cameron settles down inside the cave. Emily peers inside... There's barely enough room for her.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Besides, it might be the only dry spot around here for miles.
Emily reaches the far side!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I knew you could do it!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I can't believe it! I made it! It feels `so` good to be...
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe it! I made it! It feels [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] good to be...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: ...Alive.
Emily slides her foot cautiously forward. Ahead of her, Cameron reaches the other side.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You're almost there! Just a little bit more!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Just a little bit more...
Emily takes it slow, easing her way along the ledge.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Breathe, Em, Breathe...
Nearby, a narrow ledge leads to a tiny, naturally-formed cave on the other side of the ravine.
Water runs off the top just like a roof.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Let's go!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I don't know, Em... This seems pretty dangerous. The rocks on this ledge are getting really wet.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, they're not going to get any drier if we stand around talking about this.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Look, seriously, if you fall, you could...
Cameron nods at the steep drop beneath the ledge.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I couldn't live with myself.
Emily looks up at him.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's not going to happen. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You promise? How can you promise that?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I promise. I'll be careful.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Fine. We'll go. But we'll go `slow.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine. We'll go. But we'll go [color=#e23b3b][i]slow.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Emily starts to head out onto the ledge, but Cameron pulls her back.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: And I'll go first.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sure. Be my guest.
Cameron steps out onto the ledge, shimmying his way out. His foot collides with a small rock, knocking it off the ledge. Emily traces its path all the way down to the bottom of the ravine!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Careful.
Emily turns her body sideways and slides along the ledge a foot at a time.
The water runs in rivulets down the steep cliff face, lapping at their shoes.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Okay, focus, Emily. You can do this.
Emily stops just in time and narrowly avoids slamming into Cameron!
In front of them, the trail gives way, forming a steep ravine that drops hundreds of feet to the ground below!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Whoa! Glad I stopped.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Me too.
She slams into Cameron!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Emily, what are you doing?!
Cameron topples forward. Flailing his arms wildly, he manages to grab hold of a nearby branch!
It suspends him from falling over the edge...
In front of them, the trail gives way, forming a steep ravine that drops hundreds of feet to the ground below!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm `so` sorry!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] sorry!

nodes.text: Emily pulls Cameron back from the edge.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I could have fallen, Emily! Try to be more careful out here, will you?
Emily doesn't know what to do, so she keeps running forward!
He hears a faint yell coming from just up ahead.
You are now playing as Emily.
`The present...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]The present...[/b]

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: ...And that's how I found you.
Emily and Cameron are now hiking through some thick woods, towards the summit. Emily walks a few steps behind Cameron.
His fleet fly out from under him! He flies over the edge, sprawling out on the rocky ground, and landing on his back with a hard `thud!`
nodes.text_bbcode: His fleet fly out from under him! He flies over the edge, sprawling out on the rocky ground, and landing on his back with a hard [b]thud![/b]

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He slowly gets back up and dusts himself off.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: At least I didn't land on my face... `Ow.`
nodes.text_bbcode: At least I didn't land on my face... [color=#e23b3b][i]Ow.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: His fleet fly out from under him! He flies over the edge, sprawling out on the rocky ground, and landing on his back with a hard `thud!`
nodes.text_bbcode: His fleet fly out from under him! He flies over the edge, sprawling out on the rocky ground, and landing on his back with a hard [b]thud![/b]

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He slowly gets back up and dusts himself off.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: At least I didn't land on my face... `Ow.`
nodes.text_bbcode: At least I didn't land on my face... [color=#e23b3b][i]Ow.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Cameron quickly turns both feet sideways like a snowboarder. He slides smoothly over the edge, nimbly landing on a flat rock below.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Phew! Thank you hot snowboard instructor from two years ago... Whatever your name was.
His fleet fly out from under him! He flies over the edge, sprawling out on the rocky ground, and landing on his back with a hard `thud!`
nodes.text_bbcode: His fleet fly out from under him! He flies over the edge, sprawling out on the rocky ground, and landing on his back with a hard [b]thud![/b]

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He slowly gets back up and dusts himself off.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: At least I didn't land on my face... `Ow.`
nodes.text_bbcode: At least I didn't land on my face... [color=#e23b3b][i]Ow.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Cameron hesitates!
Cameron runs off.
He races along a bend in the trail, barely able to navigate the jagged stones beneath his feet!
He suddenly comes upon a sharp drop and he...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I find it hard to believe neither of you know where Emily is, considering she was hiking with you this whole time.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Like I said, we, um, haven't seen her.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Actually, we... We did kind of...
Hannah steps hard on Jane's foot!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Er! We haven't seen her since we left!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I `know` you're lying!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] you're lying!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Do you really `know` that?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you really [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] that?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Grr! I'll deal with both of you later.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'd stay, but unlike the two of you, I actually care about Emily.
Previously on `Surviving High School...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Previously on [b]Surviving High School...[/b]

nodes.text: On the way to a swim team retreat, Emily inadvertently made Hannah and Jane jealous by talking to Cameron.
They responded by abandoning Emily on the trail during a team-building hike to the top of Mount Collins!
Cameron came back for Emily, and the two of them headed for the mountaintop together. Along the way, Cameron promised to explain his odd behavior, but before he could...
They discovered that they were lost!

nodes.title: Swim Team Retreat, Part 2
nodes.subtitle: Will Emily and Cameron survive in the wild?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Emily.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I can't believe this... How'd we end up so lost?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Must have made a wrong turn. We want to be over there.
Cameron points to a peak off in the distance. Dark storm clouds gather at the top.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: That's probably where the rest of the team is.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Great...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hey, Em, don't worry.
He reaches over and tenderly moves a strand of hair out of her face.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: We're going to be okay.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey! What did I say about flirting with me?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: How is that flirting? All I did was move your hair.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, and all you did was sit next to me on the bus, `rescue me,` and then stare deeply into my eyes like you're some hot, weird, creeper!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, and all you did was sit next to me on the bus, [color=#3b78e2][i]rescue me,[/i][/color] and then stare deeply into my eyes like you're some hot, weird, creeper!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: So you think I'm hot?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Not funny. When are you going to tell me what's going on with you?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Later. Now's not the time. Right now, we need to head towards the summit.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Fine. You sure the team's there?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Based on when I last saw them, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And when was that?
You are now playing as Cameron.
Several hours ago...
Cameron is hiking up the trail toward the summit. Sam and Amanda are ahead of him, barely within earshot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're making pretty good time, don't you think, Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You can `make` time?!
nodes.text_bbcode: You can [color=#3b78e2][i]make[/i][/color] time?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I wish. If we could, I'd make it tomorrow.
Cameron glances behind him expectantly... But he doesn't see anyone.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: That's funny, I thought Hannah, Jane, and Emily were `right` behind me...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's funny, I thought Hannah, Jane, and Emily were [color=#e23b3b][i]right[/i][/color] behind me...

nodes.text: He turns and runs back down the trail...
After a moment, he spots Hannah and Jane hiking up.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hannah! Jane! Are you two okay?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah, we're fine now that you're here.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Don't be so forward, Hannah. You look pathetic.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Have you seen Emily?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Uhhhh...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: She `was` right behind us, but I thought she passed us.
nodes.text_bbcode: She [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] right behind us, but I thought she passed us.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You're sure she's not ahead of you? I just assumed since she kind of has that reputation for hanging around guys...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You know what I mean.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Actually, I have no idea what you mean.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Yeah, um, she's always giving off strong, flirtatious signals! You know, gawking or rubbing her face or pointing her elbows out like a chicken.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Uh, wow. That really explains your problems with guys.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Okay, maybe I don't know what flirting is!
Emily rubs the stick back and forth along her palms, hoping to see smoke rise from the kindling at the base.
A small flame forms, and Emily blows on the tiny twigs, spreading the fire to the rest of the kindling.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Come on! Start!
Emily and Cameron stare at the flame expectantly as a wind rushes through, nearly blowing it out.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Don't you dare!
`Foomp!` The flame spreads to a thicker branch, soon Emily and Cameron are huddled around a bona fide fire!
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Foomp![/b] The flame spreads to a thicker branch, soon Emily and Cameron are huddled around a bona fide fire!

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Woohoo!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You did it, Em! That was like watching a nature channel special or something!
Emily and Cameron spend the next few minutes getting warm and chatting.
But it doesn't last. Eventually, the fire dies out.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: At least we were warm for a while.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: True... Until now, I don't know if I've ever really appreciated the thermostat in my house.
Zach steps forward.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: It was my fault too. I let Emily fall behind.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And mine too.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: And mine.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It was my fault too.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: It was... It was my fault... That's for sure.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It was my fault too.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I mean... I'm sorry.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It was my fault!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Emily? What are you...?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Just `trust` me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Just [color=#3b78e2][i]trust[/i][/color] me.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Your fault?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I stayed back because I was feeling excluded from the team.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It was stupid of me.
Emily gives Hannah and Jane a quick look.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Because I had isolated myself, I got stuck...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Cameron came back for me.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Is that true?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Yes...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Then I owe you one. I'm sorry.
Emily can't summon the courage to interrupt Cameron!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: It was...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: It was my fault. You're right, but not in the way you think.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Don't you presume to know what I'm thinking.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I think that you think I was trying to take advantage of your daughter.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Be very careful with how you phrase your next few sentences, young man.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm not interested in Emily like that.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Then how is this your fault?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I let Emily fall behind. That's not how a team is supposed to work...
An alarm goes off on Jane's phone.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: We've gotta get back.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I can only imagine what my dad must be going through.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: And I can only imagine how he reacted when he found out you two abandoned Emily!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: He, uh, really flipped out! That was definitely his reaction!
Hannah nudges Jane, and the four of them head toward the summit.
At the summit, Emily, Cameron, Hannah, and Jane arrive...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hannah's back! And the rest of them too!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! More people I know!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Took you guys long enough.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is everyone in one piece?
Emily nods at Jane as she limps along.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: For the most part.
Across the way, Emily locks eyes with her father.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Emily!
He runs over and pulls her in for a big hug!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I... I don't know what I would have done...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm okay, Dad.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I know, but...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I know.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I'm just glad you're all right.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: She was a real trooper. All the way. You raised one heck of a--
Cameron's words are cut short by a look from Coach Kessler.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Don't talk to me about my daughter!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Dad!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: This is `your` fault, young man!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] fault, young man!

nodes.text: Emily sees Cameron eying Hannah and Jane.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: He's going to tell on them!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: It was--

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's what this whole trip has been about, hasn't it?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: We don't always like each, but when the chips are down, isn't being there what matters most?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It is. I... I can't thank you enough, Emily.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: So you just did it because you're `that` good, is that it?
nodes.text_bbcode: So you just did it because you're [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] good, is that it?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I didn't realize how stuck-up you were until now. We can't all be perfect, you know.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey, `I` saved `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] saved [color=#3b78e2][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Why don't you rub your greatness in my face a little more?!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Because, uh...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Because she had to!
Hannah closes her eyes and lets go! She falls through the air...
...Right into Emily's arms!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You caught me!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What did you think was going to happen?
A moment later, Cameron shows up with Jane in his arms.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: She hurt her ankle, and then wandered off to try and find help.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Ow. It's still tender... I guess I'm only an Amazon in spirit.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Come on, let's try to get out of the rain as much as we can.
Soon after, the four of them find cover from the rain underneath a thick canopy of trees.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What happened to you two? Where are the others?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We felt bad about what we did, so we came looking for you. Jane and I were up on that ridge over there when we got caught in this mudslide.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It tossed us over the edge, and that's how Jane messed up her ankle.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Uh... Thanks for helping us.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah...
The word hangs there for a moment.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: 'Yeah'? 'Yeah'?! That's all you have to say!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: She just saved you! And all you can say is `yeah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: She just saved you! And all you can say is [color=#e23b3b][i]yeah![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Cameron...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I guess I'm a little speechless.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I just can't believe she caught me. I... I don't know that I would have done the same if she had been the one to abandon me.
Hannah turns to Emily.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I treated you like dirt, and you had every opportunity to make me pay for it. Why did you help me?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Don't get me wrong, I'm still `really` mad... At both of you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't get me wrong, I'm still [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] mad... At both of you.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But I helped you because...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: The situation is what it is, Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: That's exactly what I would say right before I let you fall!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You don't have a choice! Come down!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: No! I'm never coming down!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Fine! Then I'm leaving you!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Wait! Don't go!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Are you going to fall?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Maybe... It's a long way down.
Hannah scoots her feet a little bit closer to the edge.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Couldn't you at least say something nice?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It would make it easier to fall if I at least thought that we were friends.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You've got to be kidding me.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It would help.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Fine. You... Uh... You have a good fashion sense.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Aww. That's really sweet of you. What about my hair? Do you like my hair?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Grr! You have great hair! Now don't push it!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Okay. Okay. I just can't believe you said my hair was great.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Please make this moment happen faster.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'm going to jump now. You ready?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yup. I'm right under you.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Three... Two... One... Now!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I do nice things for other people.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Are you interviewing me?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Like what?!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I don't know! I donate to charities, I volunteer on Thanksgiving, I help old ladies cross the street.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Wow... You really `are` nice.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow... You really [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] nice.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm glad that you've confirmed that. Are you going to fall?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yes. One question though... Have you ever `really` helped an old lady cross a street?
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes. One question though... Have you ever [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] helped an old lady cross a street?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well... One time I tried, but she thought I was trying to take her groceries.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Hahaha! What happened?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: She swatted me a couple times with her purse.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: That's great.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: The point is... I'm nice and I'm honest, and I'm telling you, I `will` catch you.
nodes.text_bbcode: The point is... I'm nice and I'm honest, and I'm telling you, I [color=#3b78e2][i]will[/i][/color] catch you.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I... I believe you. You ready?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm ready.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Cameron, I already know where you're going with this.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm... I'm not like that. You're great and all, but...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Are you seriously giving me this talk? I invented this talk.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Do you know what it's like? Every time I say anything to a girl, they assume I'm flirting with them.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, you do have a reputation.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Maybe so, but I was going to suggest that we huddle together, you know, for warmth.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oooohhhh... And that's it?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: That's it.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sorry, I thought...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I know what you thought.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Does the offer still stand? 'Cause I'm slowly turning into an ice sculpture over here.
Cameron looks out beyond the cave for a moment...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Sure.
Emily scoots over so her shoulder touches Cameron's.
He opens up his jacket, and she puts her arms around him, instantly feeling the warmth of his body.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: How are you this warm?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I've always been this way. When it's cold, it's a blessing. When it's warm, it's a curse.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Life of a hot guy.
Emily frowns up at him.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Life of a warm guy?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, I appreciate it now.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: So, where'd you learn this cavewoman fire stuff?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: From my dad... And Sara. We used to come out to the woods, and my dad would teach us all kinds of survival techniques.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: That's pretty cool... I mean, it always seems like he cares about you and that he cared about Sara... Fiercely.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Very` fiercely.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Very[/i][/color] fiercely.

nodes.text: Cameron takes a deep breath...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm going to tell you what I meant to tell you before.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You sure?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Go ahead...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Okay... Here goes...
Cameron takes another big breath, then...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I used to have a pretty big crush on your sister.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: She was everything I wanted in a girlfriend, but I was too stupid to do anything about it. Too much pride.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: We used to talk... Or I used to talk to her. She wanted nothing to do with me. Just like you.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sisters, remember?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: How could I forget? You look just like her.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Ever since Sara passed, I've felt... I `feel`... Responsible for you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ever since Sara passed, I've felt... I [color=#e23b3b][i]feel[/i][/color]... Responsible for you.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What?
Cameron puts his arm tightly around Emily.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I haven't been flirting with you, Emily. It's not about that. It's different and deeper and... And more.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm not going to let anything bad happen to you...
Outside the cave, the rain pours down into the ravine far below.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: This doesn't count, by the way.
Emily laughs...
She feels relieved, as if for the first time she doesn't have a burden she didn't know she was carrying...
It's as if her grief isn't alone...
A sudden scream pierces the air!

nodes.speaker: Scream
nodes.text: Heeeeeeeeelp!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: What was that?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Come on!
Emily scrambles out of the cave!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Em! Wait!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: There's no time! Someone could be in trouble!
Emily runs in the direction of the screaming, away from the ledge, Cameron chasing behind her.

nodes.speaker: Scream
nodes.text: Heeeeeeeeelp! Somebody!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I can't see anything!
Emily trips over a rock, slips on the other side, and scrapes her leg against a jagged branch.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Be careful, Em!
Emily doesn't stop running, weaving along a path, and scrambling around a large boulder...
Another scream rings out from above!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: `Heeeeeelp!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Heeeeeelp![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Above, Hannah is hugging a rocky cliff face twenty feet off the ground!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Who's down there? Help! Help!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's me, Hannah! It's Emily.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Oh no! No! No! No! No! `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no! No! No! No! No! [color=#3b78e2][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Is Cameron with you? I want Cameron.

nodes.speaker: Distant Voice
nodes.text: Help! Somebody help!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: That sounds like Jane! I'll go find her! You help Hannah!
Cameron runs off in the direction of Jane's calls for help.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Wait! Switch roles! Don't leave me!
Emily rolls her eyes and walks to the spot underneath Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Cameron? Cameron? Are you there?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's just me, Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'm stuck.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I noticed.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What, um, what happens now?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You can't climb back up?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: No, genius! If I could climb back up then I wouldn't be asking for help, would I?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I think if you're going to be asking for help, you probably shouldn't insult the person trying to help you.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Fine. So what do I do?
Emily thinks about it for a moment and realizes Hannah's only option. She sighs...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: The trust fall.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: The trust fall. You're going to have to close your eyes, fall back, and I'll catch you.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You're crazy! It's called the `trust` fall. If you think I trust you after I abandoned you, think again!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're crazy! It's called the [color=#3b78e2][i]trust[/i][/color] fall. If you think I trust you after I abandoned you, think again!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Besides, if the situation were reversed, I would never trust me to catch you!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: We'll have to hold each other... You know, for body warmth.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: This isn't a move, I swear... It's just...
Cameron shivers.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: It's just really cold.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh... Sure. Do I have to tell you what happens if you get the wrong idea?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I wouldn't dream of it.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Those `are` our genders... What are you saying?
nodes.text_bbcode: Those [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] our genders... What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm saying that you're not my biggest fan right now, the flirting thing. But there's only one way we can keep warm.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What is?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Well, here we are, freezing together, a guy and a girl...
Emily tries to rub the stick as fast as she can, but nothing happens.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I swear, I used to be really good at this.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: It's okay...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hold on.
Emily tries again, hoping to see smoke wafting up from the kindling at the base of the stick, but nothing happens.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Emily... It's okay. You're not a miracle worker.
Emily nods and gives up, laying the stick down beside her.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm sorry.
She tightens her jacket, bundling up against the cold as much as she can.
You are now playing as Emily.
Back inside the tiny cave...
Emily and Cameron shiver as they try to start a fire.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Fun retreat.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Heh. I'd rather be doing laps against the resistance belt.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'd rather be listening to another lecture from Mr. Sanderson about the historical importance of wheat.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I think I'd draw the line there. Freezing in a cave with you is marginally better than a wheat lecture.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm flattered.
Cameron holds up two sticks.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: How is this supposed to work? These sticks are damp. I'm no science genius like your boyfriend, but you can't start a fire with wet things.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You just need some friction. Here.
Emily places the stick down so that the base of it is snug against the kindling she and Cameron gathered.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: All you have to do is rub the stick back and forth like this, you know, like you're making a snake out of clay.
Emily places the stick between her palms and starts rubbing back and forth...
The other students talk happily.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Sports tournaments?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heck yeah!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: A Hollywood Prom? Count me in!

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: It'll be `so` glamorous!
nodes.text_bbcode: It'll be [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] glamorous!

nodes.text: The audience bursts into applause.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you, everyone!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Remember to vote for $ZOE!
Taylor dismisses the assembly, then draws $ZOE to the side.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Nice speech.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm glad you didn't embarrass me up there.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks. I think.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, it's totally a good thing. If I like you, the people like you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And if they like you, they'll vote for you for Social Chair in November.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... Do they like me?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Are you serious? Haven't you heard what they've been saying?
$ZOE's phone beeps.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's him!
$ZOE grabs a sweater from her closet and pulls it on over her sundress.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You look great.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Bye, Sam!
Howard guides his car to a stop along the curb outside $ZOE's house.
$ZOE flies towards the car, and the grin on her face makes Howard smile.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is a sight I missed... Let's get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because you've made a budget before?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Er, no...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So you know exactly what amount you're going to budget out for everything?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, it'll take a bit of `research...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it'll take a bit of [color=#3b78e2][i]research...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, so maybe it's going to be a little hard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I'll finish it. No worries.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No matter how long it takes. I'm going to stay up until I finish it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, okay.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just be careful, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I will. You know I will.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard's taking me to the amusement park.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The amusement park? That's like forty-five minutes away. Aren't you going to be out late?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, you're starting to sound like your mom.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, I know. But seriously, don't you have that budget thing to turn in to Taylor tomorrow?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A lot of good things are going on in my life.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know if my relationship with Howard will work out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But right now, I'm happy.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're right. I'll... I'll be happy for you.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ease up? Go with the flow?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, I can't! You're my cousin, $ZOE. We have to look out for each other!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, it just seems like you're looking to blame Howard!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Someone has to!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard wouldn't hurt me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And you know, that's exactly what I thought of Nick.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's different!
$ZOE sees the hurt look on Sam's face and sighs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Or at least I hope it is. Howard is different. I thought you liked him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I do... But I like you more.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Howard` didn't have to watch you go all emo and mopey for three months.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Howard[/i][/color] didn't have to watch you go all emo and mopey for three months.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think you two should fight over Owen.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Don't worry about it, $ZOE. We'll figure it out.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You just get ready for your date with Howard!
$ZOE walks towards the parking lot, as the cheerleaders chatter away.
At home, Sam helps $ZOE prepare for her date with Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you think I should wear my cute flower top or my green sundress?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm surprised you haven't run out of 'date' clothes already.
$ZOE pulls on her green sundress.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You two have been on a date every single night for the past week. Since the fundraiser, you two have been inseparable.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I thought you and Howard were over. What happened?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's complicated...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Can't we just talk about you and Nick?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If you don't want to talk about something complicated, that's the wrong thing to pick at.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And that's not going to distract me. Tell me what's going on.
$ZOE's mind wanders back to the week before...
At the end of the fundraiser, $ZOE thanks Howard for bringing the dunk tank.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, I would've done this for you any day. I...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm still in love with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know what to say.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You don't have to say anything. Or do anything.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know that we can pick up where we left off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All I know is that I want to see you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We don't have to go anywhere specific or do anything in particular, but can we just spend more time together?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... You two are going out, but you're not dating.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No. We haven't even kissed yet! We're just trying to see if anything is still there.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You've been on so many dates, you're practically back together.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just like spending time with him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So do people who date, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Forget it, Sam. No matter what we are right now, I still want to see him before he goes out of town.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And when is that exactly? He's already been here for a week.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's on break.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: For what holiday?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Vernal Equinox.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And now I'm suspicious again.
$ZOE shakes her head.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, can't you...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ugh, gross. Deep? I hate it when guys are all brainy and have backstory.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Way too much talking.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, he's not your type.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Too bad, huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I threw Nicole off... But I don't even know why I reacted like that.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Maybe `you're` not into that stuff, but I enjoy a guy who has some depth to him.
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] not into that stuff, but I enjoy a guy who has some depth to him.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And Owen is one of the most popular guys in school right now.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey, I haven't given up!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Maybe you're not his type. Maybe Owen is into brunettes.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Don't you dare, Maria. You `always` steal my cute guys.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't you dare, Maria. You [color=#3b78e2][i]always[/i][/color] steal my cute guys.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Troubled like a rebel?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: They're so exciting. And mysterious. And handsome. And Colt.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Well, not always that last one.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what if Nicole's interested? It's not my business anymore.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I agree, Nicole. Bad boys are definitely hot right now.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: If you want to date him, you're going to have to trample me first.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Gladly. In high heels.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, so the Student Council meets tomorrow morning at 7:30 sharp.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You have until that time to get me a solid budget. Do you understand?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great! See you tomorrow!
After the assembly, $ZOE hums happily while the cheerleaders talk around her.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You seem really happy, $ZOE... I always hum when I'm happy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It just feels like everything's going my way!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've got the endorsement from Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm creating the budget for the Halloween Dance...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I'm going out with Howard tonight!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You are really lucky. Dating a college guy is awesome!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, we're not `exactly` dating...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, we're not [color=#3b78e2][i]exactly[/i][/color] dating...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I get it... Being exclusive isn't `in` at the moment.
nodes.text_bbcode: I get it... Being exclusive isn't [color=#3b78e2][i]in[/i][/color] at the moment.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Er, no... It's not like that...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey! Look alive, guys! Hottie at twelve o'clock!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Twelve o'clock? Lunchtime! Woop woop!
Nicole waves at Owen who's walking their way.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hi, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hi, Nicole...
Everyone says hello to Owen. When he looks at $ZOE, he smiles.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE, I heard Taylor's speech. Congratulations.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess that means you're a shoo-in for the position.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not exactly.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Half a shoe, then?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha. Taylor did just put me in charge of making a budget for the dance.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's... Good?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just glad she trusts me. Good thing I'm in that finance class, right?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Good thing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, uh, the finance class started yesterday, but I didn't see you there.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I, uh, already took a class like that at my old school, so I'm taking Psychology instead.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aw, I was hoping we'd have at least one class together this quarter.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's too bad. Maybe next time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, maybe we can hang out sometime?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure. I'll see you around, okay?
Owen walks away.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Poor guy... He looks so `single.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Poor guy... He looks so [color=#3b78e2][i]single.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Just think how much happier he'd be with a `redhead` on his arm.
nodes.text_bbcode: Just think how much happier he'd be with a [color=#3b78e2][i]redhead[/i][/color] on his arm.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Ha ha, Nicole, you're so obvious.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Sometimes you have to be if you want to get a date.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So $ZOE, you and Owen are real close. What do you think of him? Should I ask him out?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, Owen is...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want Nicole to go out with Owen. What should I say?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen is...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's what I like to hear.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Always eager to please.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Aren't you cute?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Every girl knows how to `spend` money.
nodes.text_bbcode: Every girl knows how to [color=#3b78e2][i]spend[/i][/color] money.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I want you to do the opposite.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course, Taylor. I get it. I won't go overboard, I swear.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Um... Spend?
The other students murmur.

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Is it me, or do those ideas suck?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Those don't sound fun at all!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: They don't `smell` fun either!
nodes.text_bbcode: They don't [color=#3b78e2][i]smell[/i][/color] fun either!

nodes.text: Taylor takes the stand away from $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Doesn't she have a great sense of humor?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What she means is that she's going to put on all the events you love! So vote for her!
Taylor dismisses the assembly then draws $ZOE to the side.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I went through all the trouble of endorsing you, and all you can say is `that?`
nodes.text_bbcode: I went through all the trouble of endorsing you, and all you can say is [color=#3b78e2][i]that?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, Taylor...
But even though $ZOE's speech wasn't that inspiring...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Pleasure doing business with you. We'll talk soon.
Nate walks out.
You are now playing as $ZOE.
The next day, Class President Taylor addresses everyone at an after school assembly.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is my least favorite topic, but... `Dress code.` Ladies, skirts can't be higher than two inches above the knees.
nodes.text_bbcode: This is my least favorite topic, but... [color=#3b78e2][i]Dress code.[/i][/color] Ladies, skirts can't be higher than two inches above the knees.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know that's depressing, but apparently no one cares if that's fashionable or not.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But, hey, last thing on the list. And this should cheer everyone up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The vote for the school's new Social Chair will be held at the Halloween Dance!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And now, a Social Chair candidate who has already proven herself to be great for the job...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She's resourceful and responsible! In fact, she brought in the most money during the fundraiser we held last week!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Give it up for $ZOE!
$ZOE walks on stage, and Taylor steps away to let her take the podium.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hello, everyone! Please vote for me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have a lot of great ideas for the rest of the school year!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: As Social Chair, I'll make sure the school hosts...
Grudgingly, Nate hands over a crisp bill.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: This is what you mean, isn't it?
Wes holds the bill up against the light of the scanner. He grins.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I seem to have found my motivation in life.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: That's great. Hurry up and get started before I slap that grin off your face.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Ever the elegant negotiator...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Shut up.
Wes quickly pockets the money.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm going to walk out.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Unexpected move, Crawford.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You didn't give me anything, and I'm not paying for another dead end.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Okay, so what's your plan now? How are you going to win $ZOE back?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: By my calculations, with Howard in the way, you're third in line.
Nate stops.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: It's going to be awfully hard to get back into her good graces as it is.
Nate turns and hands Wes a crisp bill. Wes clears his throat, and Nate hands him another bill.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You'd better find something this time.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I always do.
You are now playing as Nate.
Late one night...
Nate walks into the school's library and finds Wes standing at the copy machine.
The light from the machine's scanner flashes, and Wes plucks a sheet from the machine's tray.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: What is that?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Side project. I have a few clients that want some assurance they'll pass Mr. Dean's mid-term on Friday.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Nothing to do with you...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Unless you're flunking English.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'd rather just get what I paid for.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Are you sure? The last time you asked me to get info on someone $ZOE liked, it didn't turn out so well for you.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I was just trying to protect her. $ZOE will see that eventually.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: So she hasn't talked to you since she found out you lied to her.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: So what makes you think it'll work this time?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: This time, she'll see that I'm the best guy for her. Now just tell me you have some dirt on Howard.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I did the standard search... And didn't get much. He's a straight arrow, that guy.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: No one's that clean.  There must be `something.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No one's that clean.  There must be [color=#e23b3b][i]something.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I'm sure there is, but it'll take a little more... `Incentive` to find it.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sure there is, but it'll take a little more... [color=#e23b3b][i]Incentive[/i][/color] to find it.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You ask too much.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Yeah, but someone has to. What are you going to do about it?
$ZOE fills in the last line right as Sam's car screeches to a halt in front of the school.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you, Sam! I'll let you know what happens!
$ZOE opens the door and runs out.
A minute later, she plunges into the Student Council's meeting room.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm so sorry! I slept straight through my alarm and--
She stops suddenly, taking stock of the room.
Taylor and Justin are glaring at her from their seats, but all $ZOE can see is Paige at the front of the room, grinning.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're late.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know... But I did bring my proposal for the budget.
Justin looks it over skeptically.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The numbers are right...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh good!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was doing some last minute calculations in the car, and I wasn't sure if they worked.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Unfortunately, while the math is fine, you're overspending how much we've allocated.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... Is that bad?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's definitely not `great.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's definitely not [color=#3b78e2][i]great.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And after Paige's well-researched budget... It's going to be hard `endorsing` yours.
nodes.text_bbcode: And after Paige's well-researched budget... It's going to be hard [color=#3b78e2][i]endorsing[/i][/color] yours.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: All I can see on this page are huge blanks where the numbers go, some doodles of flowers, and a unicorn!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought they would be pretty?
Justin swings back to the front, his attention back on Paige.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm just glad `some` members of the student body took the assignment seriously.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm just glad [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] members of the student body took the assignment seriously.

nodes.text: Paige clears her throat, causing Taylor to turn as well.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: As I was saying before $ZOE ruined the moment...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If we make some major cutbacks in the decorations department due to my dad's rather extensive network of connections, we can spend more on food and music!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good work, Paige. I wasn't sure what to expect when you said you'd created your own budget.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I'm impressed. You've really thought this through.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought I was in charge of the budget...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And now you're not.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Paige did a better job than you, $ZOE, and I'm going to use her budget to start arguing for funds for the dance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it's going to get around that you took Paige's side.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about the endorsement?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Look, $ZOE, I want the best person for this job.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And after today, I just don't know if you're it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But who's going to organize the Halloween Dance?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll think about it. Okay? Right now, I have to go to the principal.
Taylor and Justin leave the room, and Paige gives $ZOE a wide smile.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow, `someone` just got dumped. And look at that, it wasn't me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, [color=#3b78e2][i]someone[/i][/color] just got dumped. And look at that, it wasn't me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The Halloween Dance budget was `my` project.
nodes.text_bbcode: The Halloween Dance budget was [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] project.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And I stole it from right under your nose.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I have to thank you, though. If your budget didn't suck so much, they never would have gone with mine.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I hope whatever kept you away was worth it.
Paige flounces out of the room, leaving $ZOE standing alone.
You have reached the end of `Season 2, Episode 4: Howard's Secret!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 2, Episode 4: Howard's Secret![/b]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, maybe not enough for a good DJ.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But good enough for a mediocre one with a limited music selection!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I'm sure that's close enough.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My brain's stuck!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's 58 dollars! Maybe. I don't know.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, I'm almost done.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We have 100 dollars for entertainment. We've spent 27 dollars to rent extra speakers for the gym.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How much is left?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Does that even make sense?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just write it down! We're almost to the school!
$ZOE writes it down and continues.
$ZOE hastily scribbles it down!
$ZOE draws a blank!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe $50?
$ZOE moves on to the next item.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We have 100 dollars specifically for renting decorations.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We can put 20 percent aside for buying new supplies...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's 20 percent of 100 dollars?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's right! One hundred minus sixty `is` forty!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's right! One hundred minus sixty [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] forty!

nodes.text: $ZOE writes it down.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, does that sound right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, I'm trying not to kill pedestrians here!
$ZOE shakes her head and writes down the first number that comes into her head.
$ZOE's pencil hovers uncertainly over the blank on her sheet.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is it 30?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just going to lay my head down for a second. It's just a little too bright in here.
$ZOE puts her head on her desk, and in no time, her eyes drift shut.
The next morning, Sam is snoring contentedly into her pillow when...
$ZOE bursts in!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam! Wake up! Quick!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Er, what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I overslept, I didn't finish the budget, and the Student Council meeting starts in ten minutes! Help, please!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know I suck at math.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're not going to do math. I just need you to drive me. Now!
Sam stumbles into her closet, pulls on some clothes, and runs with $ZOE to the car.
In the car, $ZOE scribbles furiously onto a sheet of paper titled 'Halloween Dance Budget'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, so if I carry the two, we'll spend six thousand dollars on Christmas lights!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yikes, six thousand dollars? It's a dance, not a light show! That's got to be wrong.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're right. Shoot. I can't do it when I'm all panicky!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Breathe,` $ZOE. `Breathe.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Breathe,[/i][/color] $ZOE. [color=#3b78e2][i]Breathe.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The numbers spin in front of $ZOE, but she focuses until they stay put.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! I have to do this!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, so 60 percent of the money we have for the dance goes into snacks and decorations.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How much is left for everything else?
At a nearby cafe, Howard and $ZOE sit in one of the large booths.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I remember the first time we went to get coffee together.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wanted to impress you so much...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And the only stories I could think of were about all the pranks my twin sisters used to pull on me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It was sweet.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's how I knew we were meant to be together.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And now?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And now... $ZOE, I have to tell you something.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Howard's on break. So what? Everyone knows that! Tell me something I don't know!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: If that's the only thing you have on him, then I want all my money back!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Does no one here understand how college works?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: There is `no such thing` as 'Vernal Equinox' break.
nodes.text_bbcode: There is [color=#e23b3b][i]no such thing[/i][/color] as 'Vernal Equinox' break.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I don't see how this is going to help me break them up.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Let me spell it out.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Howard `lied.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard [color=#e23b3b][i]lied.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: And you of all people should know what happens when you lie to $ZOE.
A smile spreads across Nate's face.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Good work. I guess that's why I pay you.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: And why you owe me a favor.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Fine, yes, whatever. I can't wait to see the look on $ZOE's face when I tell her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, I haven't been completely honest with you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The truth is...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The truth is that there's no school break. I'm not on vacation.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I lied. I made it up. The Vernal Equinox is in spring anyway. It was stupid, I know, but I panicked.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't understand. If you're not on break, what are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I spent the first month at college immersing myself in my classes, in my clubs, in the Kingston King program.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I was doing really well.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I wasn't happy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So you dropped out of school and lied to cover it up?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I didn't drop out! I left. I'm still enrolled, but I'm just not attending all my classes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, that's not like you. What about your future? You're throwing that away.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And what about our future? I don't want to throw that away either.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I may have lied to you about how I got here, but I never lied about `why`.
nodes.text_bbcode: I may have lied to you about how I got here, but I never lied about [color=#e23b3b][i]why[/i][/color].

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I came back because nothing I achieved in college could make up for `you.` For what I felt for you. For what we had.
nodes.text_bbcode: I came back because nothing I achieved in college could make up for [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color] For what I felt for you. For what we had.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I came back because I love you, and I want us to be together again.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, when you left... It was hard. Really hard. And now...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, I don't have all the answers...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just know how I feel.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And that was enough for me to drop everything and come back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But what I've been wondering all this time is...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is it enough for you?
Howard meets her eyes, his face awash with hope.
And $ZOE thinks about all the times they had together and takes a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...It is.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It is enough.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know how we're going to make it work...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But we'll figure out a way.
Later, $ZOE skips into her room.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard and me... Together again...
She sits on her bed, changes into her pajamas, and curls into bed happily.
Then, suddenly, one thought pushes through.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The budget!
A few minutes later, $ZOE is sitting at a desk in the den. She pulls out a blank sheet of paper from her binder.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, so if we do a Halloween dance, we'll need decorations...
She writes down 'Decorations'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And that costs...
$ZOE yawns.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That costs three hundred pillows--

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, `dollars!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, [color=#3b78e2][i]dollars![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Round that to the nearest ten, and--
She lets out another big yawn.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I need to stay awake! Must... Fight... Sleep...
But $ZOE can't resist sleep any longer. She has no choice.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know, I had a great time tonight.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I'm so excited for our date tomorrow! You have no idea!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Me too!
$ZOE skips into her room and closes the door. Sam comes in a minute later.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, how was it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It was perfect. We went on the carousel, I won him a prize, `and` we went boating!
nodes.text_bbcode: It was perfect. We went on the carousel, I won him a prize, [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] we went boating!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So you didn't talk about when he's going back or what's going to happen when he does?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I told you, Sam. He's on vacation. Besides, it just didn't seem like the right time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'll talk about it when it comes up.
And for the next couple weeks...
Howard and $ZOE keep going on more and more dates.
They eat fancy meals at fancy places...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I didn't know they made forks so tiny!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't know there was a wrong way to eat!
They catch basketball games...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, dunk it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Go, winning team!
They spend more and more time together until it starts affecting $ZOE's personal life...
In the hallways...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So then I told Nick that he was being silly. Of course I wasn't `really` going to smash his camera.
nodes.text_bbcode: So then I told Nick that he was being silly. Of course I wasn't [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] going to smash his camera.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course not!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But sometimes, when you're angry, you sound like you're serious.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Howard... Butt out.
In class...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Did I ever tell you how much I love having you in my life?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... But I wish you wouldn't do it... When class has already started...
Howard seems to notice the rest of the class staring at them.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry.
And then one day, $ZOE and Howard come home and find Sam and the cheerleaders in her bedroom.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hi guys... What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, this is an intervention.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: For what?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: For you and Howard. You two are spending way too much time with each other!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's like you've become the same person!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We have not!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't get me started on what your issues are.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If you two want to be together, that's fine. But what you're doing is not good for you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And in Howard's case, it's just plain creepy.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I hate to say it, but she's right.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And you all feel this way?
The girls all nod in unison.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that's too bad. Because Howard and I were meant to be. And no one can take that away!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not my school, not his university, and certainly not your intervention!
$ZOE runs out of the room, taking Howard with her.
Uh-oh! Looks like $ZOE might be taking things a little too far with Howard!
Maybe if $ZOE had stopped to ask Howard a few more pointed questions, she could have balanced her life better.
One thing's for sure...
$ZOE has failed.
