nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Psh. What's it like being jealous of me all the time?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen, it's okay. You don't have to insult Paige on my behalf. Don't stoop to her level.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, translation, butt out!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Anyway, before I was so rudely interrupted...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Special? Wait, you think I'm special? Is it this outfit?
As Paige tries to guess Owen's meaning, Owen and $ZOE share a smile.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It could be my shoes. They're imported from Italy.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It wasn't your shoes I was referring to.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh... Well... Anyway...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... What you want doesn't matter.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?!
Owen looks to Spencer, who urges him on.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No one cares about being courteous to you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How dare you?! I'm sacrificing `my` time so that `you` can show me what `your` life is like!
nodes.text_bbcode: How dare you?! I'm sacrificing [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] time so that [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] can show me what [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] life is like!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If you're not going to help me, then I can make your life miserable. Is that what you want?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh...
Spencer whispers.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Stay the course!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't care. You're unimportant.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, then.
Paige takes a carton of milk and throws it in Owen's face!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm sure you didn't care about that, did you?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can't `wait` to give my presentation in Mr. Dean's class! I am going to `ruin` you!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't [color=#3b78e2][i]wait[/i][/color] to give my presentation in Mr. Dean's class! I am going to [color=#3b78e2][i]ruin[/i][/color] you!

nodes.text: Paige storms off.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Great advice, Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Worked like a charm. Now she won't be bothering you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That wasn't my goal!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, well... For the future, that's pretty much how that goes. Like, every time. Only usually with something messier than milk.
Suddenly Paige comes storming back in! She rips a plate of spaghetti off a nearby table and hurls it into Owen's lap!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Ruin! You!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ruin! You![/i][/color]

nodes.text: She leaves again before Owen can respond, the spaghetti sauce running down his leg.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: There it is!
Looks like Owen got what was coming to him! Play again and see if you can avoid a dairy disaster!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Have I ever told you how much I appreciate your honesty?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't argue with me, Owen! I want--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait... What?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're always really upfront about what you're feeling, and I find that very refreshing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, well... That's... Confusing.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You said you wanted courtesy. Why don't I show you how the cafeteria works?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on... Let's go get a tray.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay... Uh... Thanks.
Owen starts to lead Paige toward the cafeteria line, but Spencer grabs him by the arm as he passes.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude, you `appreciate her honesty?` What kind of linebacker are you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Dude, you [color=#e23b3b][i]appreciate her honesty?[/i][/color] What kind of linebacker are you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: A smart one... Sorry, Spencer. But Ben lives in a mansion, and you don't actually know any rich girls.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Right... Hmm... Maybe I should start complimenting them...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Look... We have to do this assignment together, whether we want to or not. I can't afford to slack on something that makes up fifteen percent of my grade.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well neither can I!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So then, how about I'll observe you today, and you'll observe me next week?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah... Or not! I'm studying `you` today!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... Or not! I'm studying [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] today!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why does the order even matter?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Duh. You should always get the bad news out of the way first, so you can be cheered up later.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So in your delusional world, my life is the bad news, and yours is the good?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There's no delusion, Owen. It's simple. I have more money than you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Anyway, when do I have to start participating in your sad little life?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Lunch. Meet me in the cafeteria.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh gross. Cafeterias are like the roach hotels of restaurants. Plus, it's `impossible` to get any table service.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh gross. Cafeterias are like the roach hotels of restaurants. Plus, it's [color=#3b78e2][i]impossible[/i][/color] to get any table service.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just meet me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever.
At lunch, Owen sits down at the Center Table and sighs.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude, I thought `I` missed football. You only played in `one` game, and you're acting like Ben here when Emily left for that trip.
nodes.text_bbcode: Dude, I thought [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] missed football. You only played in [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] game, and you're acting like Ben here when Emily left for that trip.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, touchy subject, buddy.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: My bad, Kale.
Spencer slaps a hand on Owen's back.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Look, football will be back, man! Is this because we won State? Don't worry! We'll win State again next year!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And the year after that! And the year after that! And the year after `that!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And the year after that! And the year after that! And the year after [color=#e23b3b][i]that![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How many years are you planning on being in high school, Spence?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't know! Squirrels forever!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's not about football, guys. It's this stupid Psychology project for Mr. Dean's class.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige is supposed to observe what my day is like. I can already imagine all the nasty things she's going to say. I just want to get through this project with my skin intact.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why didn't you just take Finances? $ZOE brought in money-themed cupcakes today. Green frosting for the win!
Ben gets $ZOE's attention at the far end of the table.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Awesome cupcakes today, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Ben! Hey, can we set aside time soon to get stuff for the Halloween Dance?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: For sure!
$ZOE's eyes drift, and for a narrow second, she makes eye contact with Owen...
But the moment passes, and she looks away.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude, are you hearing me? Dealing with rich girls is easy. Whatever they say, you just say 'that's not important'.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: As soon as Paige gets critical, man up and tell her that her opinion isn't important.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Won't that just make her mad?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, man, `crazy` mad! But she'll come around. In no time she'll be treating you with the respect you deserve!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, man, [color=#e23b3b][i]crazy[/i][/color] mad! But she'll come around. In no time she'll be treating you with the respect you deserve!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That... Sounds like a horrible idea.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Poindexter weighs in... What's your advice?
Spencer adopts a nasally accent.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: 'Gee! Apply nerd formula to vector B and then triangulate the signal! Solve for girls!'

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Very funny. Look, take it from me, Owen. If you want to neuter Paige's criticisms, you'll 'kill her with kindness.'

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Compliment her. It'll take all the wind out of her. Trust me.
As if on cue, Paige bursts into the cafeteria, her nose crinkled in disgust as she rushes toward the safety of the Center Table.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can't believe you're forcing me to eat in this jail cell!
Paige sits down and notices Owen's tray.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait... Where's `my` food?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... Where's [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] food?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You have to get it yourself. That's how cafeterias work.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh no. I'm not doing that. Go get it for me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, I'm not your servant.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh! Forget it. I just wanted some courtesy!
Owen sneaks a glance at Spencer and Ben.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ahem. Not important. Cough.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Kindness!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Go on.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She's made of money, Mr. Dean. And she reminds me of it every two seconds.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can't help being well-off.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: See? I'm not like that. I didn't grow up with much.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: And you feel like this will make the assignment difficult?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, people like her aren't supposed to hang out with people like me.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: A very astute observation, Owen.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: It's also precisely the reason I've paired you two up.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... Switching partners is...?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Not in the cards. Still, I'll give you some leniency on your grade for impressing me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'll take it.
Mr. Dean walks away, whistling to himself.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey! Maybe if you bathed more, I wouldn't have to give you so many hygiene tips.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do you brush your hair with the same silver spoon you were born with?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Dumb! None of my maids brush my hair with a spoon!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And there was nothing absurd about what you just said, right?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Enough! Owen, yes, she's mean to you, but you're mean right back, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: So... I've chosen you two because people of different backgrounds can often learn the most from each other.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No thanks. I don't need to know anything more about dressage.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ha! That implies that you actually know something to begin with.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: That's it. You're stuck with each other. Deal with it.
Mr. Dean walks away, mumbling something about long hours and low pay.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, I'm actually running late for class, so I think I'll go.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Bye, Owen.
As Owen walks away, he overhears Howard say...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, I mean, I know you and Howard have a history... I just thought, maybe, you know... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh boy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why would you say that, man?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know. I was just trying to... Relieve the tension.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, now this feels even more awkward.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, it's more awkward now.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It feels like it gets more awkward every time you guys use the word `awkward.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It feels like it gets more awkward every time you guys use the word [color=#e23b3b][i]awkward.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You just used it `twice!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You just used it [color=#e23b3b][i]twice![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know. Look, can we just start over or something?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think this already feels really weird.
The bell rings for the start of class.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um, fine. It's really nice of you to ask!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know how much you care about it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Look!
The cheerleaders all stare wide-eyed at Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I get it! $ZOE and Howard are amazing together!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's like his words are nice, but his face is mean!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Isn't there something more productive you can do with your time than gossip about other people's lives?!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: That's easy... No. There isn't!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well then do me a favor and shut up about $ZOE and Howard!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why are they so special? Why do you insist on talking about them? Why do they matter?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: They matter because all of us wish every day of our lives that we could find something even a little bit as special as what they have, okay?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: They're our symbol of hope.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah, and they're really cute together too!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but $ZOE and Howard are obnoxious and annoying!
The cheerleaders gasp!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You did `not` just say that.
nodes.text_bbcode: You did [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] just say that.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not cool, bro.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: $ZOE is as obnoxious and annoying as you are cool and nice. And in case you can't tell, that means neither of you are any of those things!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: How dare you come into our school and say that, new guy!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: New guy? But I helped you win the State Championship!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah, with $ZOE's help!
The cheerleaders swarm around Owen, surrounding him.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What... What are you doing? I have class to go to.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You're not going anywhere until you take it back!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Take it back?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Say that you love $ZOE and Howard together!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? I can't say that!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't tell you... I just can't!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: If you want to go to class you will! It's not that hard... After all, they're perfect together.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: No one's better than $ZOE and Howard!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Nooo...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Nooo...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Get over it, dawg. You know Howard's the best guy!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: And we're not leaving you alone until you say $ZOE and Howard are perfect together!
They crowd inches closer to Owen, backing him up against the lockers.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Fine! `$ZOE and Howard are perfect together!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine! [color=#e23b3b][i]$ZOE and Howard are perfect together![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen stands there, back against the lockers, gasping for breath.
The cheerleaders smile and move aside, but as Owen walks to class, he feels like he's lost a part of himself...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I should have kept my emotions in check...
He steps outside, rounds the corner behind the school for a breather...
And bumps right into $ZOE and Howard mid-makeout session!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen!
$ZOE separates from Howard.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Awkward!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, sorry... I didn't see tongue... Er! I didn't see `you` there.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, sorry... I didn't see tongue... Er! I didn't see [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] there.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I haven't seen you much at all since the fundraiser...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Been real busy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Cool.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Cool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Cool.
Owen kicks at a piece of trash on the ground.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So...

options.label: How's the Social Chair thing going?

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'll see what I can find...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Excuse me.
Owen leaves the cheerleaders, relieved that he managed to keep his composure in front of them.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Right. Excuse me. I'm going to go get some air before I... Before my Psych class starts.
Owen tries to walk away, but Maria pulls him back.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Wait!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We were thinking... Since you're super cool, and since you and $ZOE are friends and all... Maybe you could get some dirt on how things are between her and Howard for us?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Leave him alone, Maria. It's none of your business.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Of course it's my business. If it happens at this school, I have to know about it. It's practically my job.
Maria turns back to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Besides, even though you're a guy, I know you're just as curious as we are to hear all the juicy details!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's... Disturbing.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And crazy romantic! It's just like that movie where that guy loves that girl but then he leaves and then he comes back and he's a zombie but they're `still` in love!
nodes.text_bbcode: And crazy romantic! It's just like that movie where that guy loves that girl but then he leaves and then he comes back and he's a zombie but they're [color=#3b78e2][i]still[/i][/color] in love!

nodes.text: The girls let out a bunch of `Awww`s all at once.
nodes.text_bbcode: The girls let out a bunch of [b]Awww[/b]s all at once.

nodes.text: Hey SHS Fans! `Sara and Nick: Novel Prelude` can now be found in More Episodes!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey SHS Fans! [b]Sara and Nick: Novel Prelude[/b] can now be found in More Episodes!

nodes.text: It includes The Storm Parts 1 and 2, the Novel Preview, and Getting Over Howard!
In the Storm, Nick and Sara enjoy several hour-long dates before tragedy strikes.
The Novel Preview provides a sneak peek at the first four chapters of the new `Surviving High School` novel, transformed into an SHS episode!
nodes.text_bbcode: The Novel Preview provides a sneak peek at the first four chapters of the new [b]Surviving High School[/b] novel, transformed into an SHS episode!

nodes.text: And in Getting Over Howard, $ZOE must handle the heartbreak of Howard being thousands of miles away! Check it out!
And now...

nodes.title: Psych Project, Subject: Owen
nodes.subtitle: Can Owen handle Paige observing his personal life?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Owen.
As he walks down the hall, he passes the cheerleaders, who are buzzing with excitement!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: OMG! Best day ever!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I'm so happy for her!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I knew this day would come. Totally called it! It does not get any smoother than my bro, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's everyone so excited for?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Howard and $ZOE got back together!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And for the record, not everyone is excited!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: She's `soooo` right. I'm more confused than excited!
nodes.text_bbcode: She's [color=#3b78e2][i]soooo[/i][/color] right. I'm more confused than excited!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Then how come you're so happy?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's Friday!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Or Thursday?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whatever... It doesn't matter! If it ends in 'day', I'm happy!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't argue with that. So, where `is` $ZOE?
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't argue with that. So, where [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Where do you think? She's probably off spit-swapping with Mr. Perfect right now...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Their faces all mashed up against each other like a couple of manatees.
Owen, thinking about $ZOE and Howard together, feels a rush of jealousy!
Owen brings the weight down and pumps it back up cleanly!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whoa! You're, like, `strong,` Owen!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! You're, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]strong,[/i][/color] Owen!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's so hot!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I mean, for a dumb jock...
Owen finishes the set with ease, putting the weight back on the rack with a light `clank.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Owen finishes the set with ease, putting the weight back on the rack with a light [b]clank.[/b]

nodes.text: After dinner, Owen and Paige talk on the front porch.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Grandma's getting ready for bed.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: She's... Nice.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, sorry about the whole 'us going to the dance' thing. She doesn't really care about boundaries, and I know you and Lee are together.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Actually... That's not true. We're kind of broken up.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Serious?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah. Turns out when all you do is make out constantly, you don't really get to know the other person.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: One of life's great lessons. I think Mr. Dean was lecturing about that the other day.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So, I know my life's not like a tour through the Taj Mahal or anything, but, uh, that's pretty much a day in the life of Owen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It was...
Paige trails off, at a loss for words.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Go ahead, say it. It was poor and gross and boring.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's not what I was going to say.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure. I guess we'll see the opposite next week, right? The rich, clean, fun life of Paige.
Paige's eyes flare for just a moment...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You might not believe this, but I'm kind of looking forward to it. I actually had fun today.
Paige closes her eyes tight, as if summoning some inner strength. They pop open!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you trying to be my friend?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, I thought--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't know what you thought, Owen, but whatever it is, it's wrong!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We're not friends, okay?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Where is this coming from?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't feel like I've been hiding what I think of your life, have I?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're poor, Owen. Beneath me. And do I need to remind you that you have some silly crush on $ZOE, `my rival` for Social Chair?!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're poor, Owen. Beneath me. And do I need to remind you that you have some silly crush on $ZOE, [color=#3b78e2][i]my rival[/i][/color] for Social Chair?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess... I guess I was wrong.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No kidding. Now if you'll excuse me, I'm going to get out of your dingy neighborhood and go somewhere `safe.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No kidding. Now if you'll excuse me, I'm going to get out of your dingy neighborhood and go somewhere [color=#3b78e2][i]safe.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Fine. See you next week... And not because I want to.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever.
Paige marches off towards her car and drives off, leaving Owen standing dumbstruck on the porch.
The front door squeaks open, and Grandma Betty pokes her head out.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I heard shouting. What happened, Owen?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I... I don't know. I was trying to tell her that I was excited to see what her life was like for my class project, and she attacked me out of nowhere.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Tsk tsk. It's never out of nowhere, hon.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It isn't? Then what happened?
Grandma Betty rolls her eyes.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Boys...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: She's scared, dear. After she saw how nice your life is, she's afraid of something about her own.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? But what does Paige have to be afraid of?
What `does` Paige have to be afraid of? Find out in next week's episode of Surviving High School!
nodes.text_bbcode: What [b]does[/b] Paige have to be afraid of? Find out in next week's episode of Surviving High School!

nodes.text: You have reached the end of `Season 2, Episode 5: Psych Project, Subject: Owen!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 2, Episode 5: Psych Project, Subject: Owen![/b]

nodes.text: Before we tally your score, a few messages...
Get your questions answered in a Friday Q and A session with author M. Doty at http://www.facebook.com/MDotyAuthor.
And remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool!
Or follow us on Twitter @SHSTeam!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Oh, posh! Where is this other girl? Is she here?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No... She's... She's dating someone else.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: A story older than me. And what's wrong with Paige? Isn't she beautiful?
Owen catches a delighted look on Paige's face.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah... She's beautiful, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: You guess. That's the problem with you men, guessing about something that's right in front of your face!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Is she pretty or not?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She's pretty, okay! I said it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: See, that wasn't so hard now, was it?

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Well, in my day if a girl came over for dinner, it had nothing to do with class!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know, Grandma. Times have changed.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: To be honest, I'm not sure who I'm going to go to the dance with.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really? What about Lee?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He and I--

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: You know, I met Harold at a dance! It was the first spring after the war...
As the table is set for dinner, Owen sees Paige starting to eat her soup.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ahem.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We have a tradition before we begin eating...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Don't worry, dear. You didn't know.
Grandma Betty reaches out her hands to Owen on her left and Paige on her right. They take her hands, and Owen reaches his hand across to Paige.
Paige hesitates for a moment and takes it. Grandma Betty smiles.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I am glad to have food today. I am glad to have my Owie. And I am glad to have his beautiful classmate, Paige, as a guest.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Your turn, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, I'm glad we won State. I'm glad I live with such a cool grandma. And, uh... I'm glad that I got this new start at Twin Branches.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: That's very nice. What about you, Paige? Three things you're glad for?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There are so many things to be glad for, I don't even know where to begin!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Oh, sweetie, that's okay. It's your first time, so just take it slow.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm glad for... All my shoes, how awesome my life is, and for my horse, William.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Quite a life! Now let's eat!
Owen, Paige, and Grandma Betty begin eating and chatting.
A little while later...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: You get to plan a dance! How wonderful!
Grandma Betty turns to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Are you taking this lovely girl to the dance?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Grandma!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: It's a perfectly innocent question! You two would make a lovely pair! Besides, how could you not fancy her? She's breathtaking!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Grandma...

options.label: She's just here for a class project.

nodes.text: Paige lowers her voice so only Owen can hear.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So? I don't have to do everything your grandma says.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But you're going to. If you didn't care about her opinion, you wouldn't be keeping your voice down.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do you need me to show you how to do this?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No! I can do it!
Paige puts the cutting board down and begins cutting scallions.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just... Don't enjoy this so much!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Very good, dear! Dinner will be ready sooner with your help!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's the assignment.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No, it isn't. I just have to try to understand your psyche... That doesn't mean doing everything you do.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But Mr. Dean said--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Mr. Dean said 'observing, `and to some extent,` participating in.' I draw the line here.
nodes.text_bbcode: Mr. Dean said 'observing, [color=#3b78e2][i]and to some extent,[/i][/color] participating in.' I draw the line here.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're drawing the line at cutting scallions? Why stop there? Why make any effort at all?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Tone `not` appreciated. Besides, I want to eat, and if `I'm` not cutting those scallions, I think you'd better get started.
nodes.text_bbcode: Tone [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] appreciated. Besides, I want to eat, and if [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] not cutting those scallions, I think you'd better get started.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Grrr...
Owen reluctantly cuts up the scallions.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Come on, kids! Chop chop! Soup waits for no man!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...One thing's for sure. You're already starting to get used to me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: As if. How did you come to that ridiculous conclusion?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Because you've been in the weight room for thirty minutes, and you haven't made one comment about how gross or vile it is.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, that's just because I've been holding my breath.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If I actually smelled anything I'd probably gag or melt or something.
Owen starts heading toward the locker room.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So... What happens next? Do we perform on the street for tips?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Relax. I'm just having fun at your expense!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That makes me feel a whole lot better. And to answer your question... We're going to my house... My grandma's house.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You live with your grandma? Wait... What about your parents?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know, Paige. Maybe you don't know `everything` about me.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know, Paige. Maybe you don't know [color=#e23b3b][i]everything[/i][/color] about me.

nodes.text: An hour later, Owen and Paige step into Owen's grandma's tiny house...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can't believe you live `here.` It's so dumpy.
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe you live [color=#3b78e2][i]here.[/i][/color] It's so dumpy.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Careful. My grandma might hear you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh... Right.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Hear what, dear?
Grandma Betty shuffles into the living room. She gasps when she sees Paige.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Oh my oh my! Who is `this` beauty? If she isn't a promising movie starlet, then I'm a retired milkman!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh my oh my! Who is [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] beauty? If she isn't a promising movie starlet, then I'm a retired milkman!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Grandma, this is Paige. She's a classmate of mine. Paige, meet my grandma.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hi, I was just saying how, um, `cozy` your home is.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hi, I was just saying how, um, [color=#3b78e2][i]cozy[/i][/color] your home is.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: You're too kind, Sweetie! This place isn't much at all. Without Harold, I've made do as best I can.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Harold was my grandpa. He passed a long time ago.
Betty pats Paige's arm.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Treasure what you've got, dear. Now, come on, we've got cooking to do!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Cooking?!
Grandma Betty takes Paige by the hand and pulls her into the adjoining kitchen. Owen follows.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Could you cut up these scallions for me, Doll?
Grandma Betty hands Paige a knife and a cutting board.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I think we have just enough ingredients for Harold's Spicy Soup! It was his favorite!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... Why doesn't your maid just cook for you?
Grandma Betty chuckles.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: A maid?! How rich! There are no maids or servants here, dear. We do `all` the work ourselves.
nodes.text_bbcode: A maid?! How rich! There are no maids or servants here, dear. We do [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] the work ourselves.

nodes.text: Paige is holding the knife like it's a dead mouse.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: For goodness' sake! Owie, help her!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure, Grandma.
Owen moves next to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owie?

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Oh, that's my Owen's nickname. When he was a little baby, he couldn't say his own name... All he could say was 'Owie'!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Grandma, we don't have to talk about when I was a baby. Like, at all.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: He loved running around the house at top speed with his bare bottom out for all the world to see!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, that's something I'll definitely include in the presentation.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How about you just focus on these scallions?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You know what? How about you do it? You probably know more about manual labor than I do.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're not getting out of this...

options.label: You have to do what I do.

nodes.text: Paige bursts into laughter!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Weightlifting must cause brain damage because that's the dumbest thing you've ever said!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You were just going to say that I'm a good guy. Tell me I'm wrong!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're wrong!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What I was going to say was this...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's bad enough $ZOE has one good guy going after her, let alone two `and` a complete nobody!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's bad enough $ZOE has one good guy going after her, let alone two [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] a complete nobody!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did you forget that Nate Crawford's interested in her? At least he's actually `someone.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you forget that Nate Crawford's interested in her? At least he's actually [color=#3b78e2][i]someone.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: His dad's the mayor, and I'm `sure` his family's wealthy.
nodes.text_bbcode: His dad's the mayor, and I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]sure[/i][/color] his family's wealthy.

nodes.text: Owen's face turns red.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can't believe you actually thought `I` liked `you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe you actually thought [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] liked [color=#3b78e2][i]you![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That might not be true, but...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: First me and Nate, now Howard! There are three guys interested in her, and that totally bothers you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Plus everyone's making a big deal about how Howard and $ZOE are back together... Kind of burst your popularity bubble, didn't it?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Argh! Yes, you're right! Just shut up about it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's always $ZOE $ZOE $ZOE! Oh, look at me, I'm $ZOE, I made a cupcake shaped like a sheep!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Pfft. Big whoop. I actually own a sheep!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's... Kind of weird.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Anyway, let's stop talking about Perfect Princess, okay?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Fine by me, but...
Owen brings the weight down... But he can't lift it back up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Help!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Help![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you doing? Aren't you supposed to be `lifting` the weight? It looks like you're just holding it against your neck...
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you doing? Aren't you supposed to be [color=#3b78e2][i]lifting[/i][/color] the weight? It looks like you're just holding it against your neck...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Help!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Help![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jacob runs over and lifts the weight off of Owen.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Dude, trying to impress a girl doesn't automatically make you stronger!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I thought I could lift it...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: No girl's worth a broken neck!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You don't know how much I'm worth!
Jacob walks away laughing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Awww... Is he right? Were you trying to impress me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'd rather not talk about it.
Owen takes a couple of deep breaths... And lifts the barbell off the support!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You don't think I can lift more? Fine. I'll prove you wrong.
Owen gets back up, pulls more weights off the rack, and sets them on the barbell.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Satisfied?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow, I can't believe you fell for that. What do I know about weights?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! Owen's whipped!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I know. And he does whatever she says too!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: That's what 'whipped' means, dummy.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Oh.
Owen sits up off the bench and looks at Jacob and Zach.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Could either of you lift this much?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Uh, well, I'm really sore.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I have a bad back from... Studying so much.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's what I thought.
He turns back to Paige.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nice try. This is a good amount of weight.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Aww... No fun.
In the weight room... Owen carries weights from a rack and sets them on a barbell for bench pressing.
As he gets into position under the barbell, Paige hovers over him.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are you actually planning to spot me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I was just wondering if you were only planning to lift this much... Is it like a warm-up for when you lift more later?
Nearby, several of the guys from the football team snicker.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Ha ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Heh. Don't let him fool you! That's the most he's ever lifted!
Owen and Paige dance seamlessly around the floor.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This is... Oddly natural.
The music fades, and Owen is left holding Paige. She stares up at him for a moment...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yes?
Paige pulls away, and Owen lets her go.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That was... Ahem... Very good. For a first-timer.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: Brilliant! Never stop! New song!
The instructor snaps his fingers, and a new song plays.
After an hour of dancing, the instructor wipes tears from his eyes.

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: In all my days, I never thought I would see such natural talent. You must return.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... Sure.

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: Good. And now that you've promised to come back, I don't care about you. Get out.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't worry about it. Come on. I need to do a little bit of shopping before we meet my dad for dinner.
Paige's car swings up to the curb.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And why is that so hard to believe?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, if you practice something, it implies that you want to get better at it.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And that makes you feel... I don't know... More human? Less like a rich girl cartoon.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If I were a cartoon, I bet you I'd be really hot.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Aaaaand... Back to a cartoon.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hee.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You just always seem so... Empty and fake.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh... I didn't mean that to sound so harsh. I meant it as a compliment, I swear!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, awesome! Let me compliment `you` the same way! You look like a dopey giraffe!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, awesome! Let me compliment [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] the same way! You look like a dopey giraffe!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige, I just meant that it was refreshing to know that you weren't as fake as I thought.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So only a little bit fake?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ummm... I'll stop talking now.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Good move.
Owen immediately steps on Paige's toes!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ow! Watch it!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sorry...
He spins her around, but her momentum is carrying her in the opposite direction!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh, hello? Clockwise! `Clockwise!` Do poor people not have clocks?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, hello? Clockwise! [color=#3b78e2][i]Clockwise![/i][/color] Do poor people not have clocks?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I forgot, okay! All my clocks are digital!

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: Stop! Stop! Stop!

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: How can I put this delicately?
The instructor points his finger at all the other dancers.

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: Good! Good! Good! Good! Good! Good! Good!
He points to Owen and Paige...

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: Horrible! Whatever your names are, get out!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But I'm Paige. I come here all the time. You just called me by my name when I walked in.

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: When you dance like you do, baby, you don't have a name.
Paige trudges out of the studio, Owen following.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks a lot!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I told you I don't dance!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If you had just shut up like I told you to, you wouldn't have had to dance in the first place!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, I'm sorry, I didn't expect to be thrusted into a dance or die situation.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Grrr! I `hate` this project!
nodes.text_bbcode: Grrr! I [color=#3b78e2][i]hate[/i][/color] this project!

nodes.text: Paige makes a beeline for a nearby clothing store.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: To let off some steam before we meet my dad for dinner!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Your friends don't seem very nice.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: They can be. But they can also be a vicious pack of dogs.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Vicious dogs... Wearing `way` too much perfume.
nodes.text_bbcode: Vicious dogs... Wearing [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too much perfume.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hee. Thanks for trying to save me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It didn't seem fair for them to gang up on you like that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I didn't realized it was up to you to protect me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh...
Paige's phone beeps, and she looks at it, frowning.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just a slight change in plans for dinner. Nothing that concerns you.
They walk through the mall, an awkward silence between them. Owen finally breaks it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... I assume we're here so you can pick up a new wig.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not even going to react to that. Actually, I'm barely shopping at all today. I have a dance class.
Paige leads Owen into a dance studio, where an instructor struts around critiquing dancers on the dance floor. He stops when he sees Paige.

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: Paige! Angel! How good of you to come! We're just starting the waltz!
Paige turns to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Have a seat. Don't touch anything. Don't say anything. Don't breathe on anything.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And if anyone asks, you don't know me. The last thing I want is someone suspecting we came together.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You know, your people skills are really improving.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I mean it. Go away. Now!
The dance instructor flitters over, his face beaming.

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: What's this? Young love blossoming in my studio?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Love? Please. I just ate.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And `I` just barf--
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] just barf--

nodes.text: Paige glares at him.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... Just... Was also grossed out.

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: You're perfect partners for the waltz!

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: Two peas in a pod! Two pigs in a blanket! Two yams in a sock!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No no no. We're not yams. We're not peas. And we're `definitely` not pigs. Bad idea.
nodes.text_bbcode: No no no. We're not yams. We're not peas. And we're [color=#3b78e2][i]definitely[/i][/color] not pigs. Bad idea.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: For once, I agree with her. Really `really` bad idea.
nodes.text_bbcode: For once, I agree with her. Really [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] bad idea.

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: Too late! It's decided!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You don't understand. It's not just because Paige is gross...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...It's a bad idea because I don't dance.
The instructor's face goes completely serious, as if hardening into stone.

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: Young man. Everybody. Dances.
With that, the instructor points his finger toward the ceiling. As if on cue, music begins playing from an unknown source.

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: You will dance... Or you will die.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: Kidding! But seriously, if you don't dance, I'll throw you out! And I'll use my claws too!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen, do not embarrass me!
Paige grabs Owen's hands and positions one in her hand, the other on her shoulder.
The other dances get into position around them.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: All you have to do in the waltz is keep the rhythm, hold your frame, and twirl me clockwise! Got it?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Instructor
nodes.text: Begin!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen, it's okay!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, I'm sorry. I can't just stand on the sidelines.
Owen turns to the girls.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige told you it isn't any of your business, so just drop it.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: O.M.G! Who do you think `you` are? We've known Paige for forever!
nodes.text_bbcode: O.M.G! Who do you think [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] are? We've known Paige for forever!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, that's obviously not long enough to have some courtesy.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Courtesy? My dad owns a dozen yachts... We can't afford to be courteous.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Speak for yourself, Priss.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: I like this new guy, Paige! He's rough around the edges, but with the right credit card, I think he'd fix right up!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Oh, and I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: Me too.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Ditto.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Ugh. Fine. Let's just shop, girls. Paige? Coming with?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You'll have to shop without me. I have to run some stupid errands with Owen.
The girls shrug their shoulders and leave.
The girls don't even flinch.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Are you joking?

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Sorry, New Guy, but where we shop, we don't really have `sales.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, New Guy, but where we shop, we don't really have [color=#3b78e2][i]sales.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: The rich don't believe in sales, discounts, or coupons. Not that you would know.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I am `so` embarrassed.
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] embarrassed.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Anyway, nice try.

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: What's a coupon? Do you put it on a salad?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: So, Paige, why `did` you transfer?
nodes.text_bbcode: So, Paige, why [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] you transfer?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Maybe to get away from all your nosiness!
The girls gasp!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Come on! Paige obviously wants to be alone with her hobo friend. So let's help her out.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Bye!
They walk away, leaving Paige.
Just then the door flings open, and $ZOE comes rushing in!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I am so so `so` sorry I'm late, Taylor! I was just trying to catch up on some homework, and I completely lost track of time!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am so so [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] sorry I'm late, Taylor! I was just trying to catch up on some homework, and I completely lost track of time!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's strike one against you! Two more, and I'm giving Social Chair to Paige!
$ZOE notices Paige and Owen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, hi, Paige. Hi... Owen. What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Psych Project.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow. I'm so shocked over here.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What's your reasoning, Owen?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well... $ZOE is nice, good-hearted, and responsible.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: See? He's way into her!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Relax. I get it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just feel like if she said she'd be here, she'll be here.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I agree. She may be too nice at times, but her word is strong... It's like dwarf armor.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Dwarf armor? When did you become... Like this?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You mean, a super awesome President who has control over your future?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Um... Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm surprised...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And impressed!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Cold-blooded, Owen. I can admire that. Want to explain yourself?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: If she said she'd be here, she should be here.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I have to apologize for `him.` He's here because of this eye-roll of a project we have to do for Psych. It's all about what happens when rich people hang out with peasants.
nodes.text_bbcode: I have to apologize for [color=#3b78e2][i]him.[/i][/color] He's here because of this eye-roll of a project we have to do for Psych. It's all about what happens when rich people hang out with peasants.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That is not the point of the project.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever. Just please try to stay in the corner there. And don't speak unless spoken to!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'll speak when I want to speak!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's not how this works! You're `observing` my life! I didn't say anything when I was observing yours!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's not how this works! You're [color=#3b78e2][i]observing[/i][/color] my life! I didn't say anything when I was observing yours!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?! You spent the entire time calling me poor and insulting my grandma's house!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How did I insult her house?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You said it looked dumpy!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: See? This is what I don't get... How can facts be insulting?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really? How about the `fact` that your face looks like a--
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? How about the [color=#e23b3b][i]fact[/i][/color] that your face looks like a--

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ahem! Last I checked, this was `my` meeting in `my` awesome Presidential office! If anyone's going to be hurling insults, it'll be me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ahem! Last I checked, this was [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] meeting in [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] awesome Presidential office! If anyone's going to be hurling insults, it'll be me!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Apologize now or get out!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I just didn't want you to think less of me for bringing along an 'unwanted' guest.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really? That's the nicest way you could phrase that?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Guys! Shut up! I don't care if Owen's here...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: He can't ruin the meeting anymore than $ZOE already has. I swear, that girl's got her priorities all mixed up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's like she's focused all her skill points on Dexterity while completely ignoring her Stamina!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, right... Uh, it's like she's wearing fab shoes with last year's outfit.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ew. `That` I understood.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ew. [color=#3b78e2][i]That[/i][/color] I understood.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You know, she's probably not coming. I don't even think she cares about Social Chair.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: First, she completely botched the budget... Now she's ditching your meeting. It's like she doesn't respect you at all.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wow. You're so right. I guess I'll just `give you` the Social Chair position!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow. You're so right. I guess I'll just [color=#3b78e2][i]give you[/i][/color] the Social Chair position!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! Who do you think you're talking to? I invented manipulation back when you were eating glue!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're only a year ahead of me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whatev. What do you think, Owen? Should we wait for $ZOE to start the meeting?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're asking him?! He's, like, `in love` with $ZOE.
nodes.text_bbcode: You're asking him?! He's, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]in love[/i][/color] with $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Is that true?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... I'm just an impartial observer.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine. Then that makes you perfect for providing an impartial opinion. So?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Last I checked, following your advice when it comes to rich girls and lessons is a bad idea.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? Do you know who you're talking to? I'm Spencer the Advice Dispenser!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I thought you were the Pain Dispenser.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It changes. Depends on what I'm dispensing.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, well. I appreciate the advice, but I'm going to pass.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige's presentation could completely ruin both my grade and my reputation...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Your loss... I want to see you working `twice` as hard the next time we workout!
nodes.text_bbcode: Your loss... I want to see you working [color=#e23b3b][i]twice[/i][/color] as hard the next time we workout!

nodes.text: Owen leaves.
A few minutes later, he arrives in Taylor's office. Taylor and Paige are there waiting. $ZOE is noticeably absent.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nice of you to finally show. I didn't want to have to come fetch you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And yuck! You smell. What were you doing? Playing in garbage?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sweating. It's that thing you do when you physically work at something, but I guess you wouldn't know anything about that.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shut up! Both of you!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine. Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Great idea! It's exactly the kind of petty, attention-grabbing stunt `she'd` pull!
nodes.text_bbcode: Great idea! It's exactly the kind of petty, attention-grabbing stunt [color=#e23b3b][i]she'd[/i][/color] pull!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha! Yeah!
Owen throws down his stuff and stays back, lifting weights with Spencer.
A few minutes later...
The gym doors fly open!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where is he?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Showtime!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh oh.
Paige marches angrily up to Owen!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did you forget that you have somewhere to be right now?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No. I just figured you deserved to be taught a lesson.
Paige gets right in Owen's face.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Do I need to remind you that tomorrow `I'll` be presenting everything I've learned about you in class?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do I need to remind you that tomorrow [color=#3b78e2][i]I'll[/i][/color] be presenting everything I've learned about you in class?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And that I have the capacity to easily ruin you?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How? By telling the class I don't have any servants?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Burn!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Shut up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can ruin you by telling everyone how your diary says that you're in love with me!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You love Paige?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No! She's making it up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You keep a diary?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Making. It. Up.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You see how easily it'd be believed, don't you? And how quickly word would reach a certain girl...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I get it. I get it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Next time you try to teach me a lesson, make sure you have something to back it up with!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Now, come on! I can't afford to look bad in front of Taylor!
A few minutes later, Paige and Owen step into Taylor's office. $ZOE is noticeably absent.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Glad `someone` could make it to this meeting.
nodes.text_bbcode: Glad [color=#3b78e2][i]someone[/i][/color] could make it to this meeting.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sorry we're late, Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Is that what we're here for?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, what else is there?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I hate to break it to you, but football isn't coming around again for a long time, Spencer. You might want to consider something else. Something not football.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You mean... Not football?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Was my statement confusing?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No. I just don't know if I'm ready for something not football.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You'll find something.
They switch places, Owen spotting Spencer as he lifts.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Man, I can't even begin to tell you how much I've been dreading today.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All day long Paige is going to be rubbing how much money she has right in my face.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Oof!` Wait... `Oof!` Are you poor, dude? `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color] Wait... [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color] Are you poor, dude? [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, my wallet's on the skinny side, but we're all poor compared to Paige. I'm just the sucker who got assigned to her.
Spencer rests for a moment.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This project seems lame, man. You should have taken Finances. I don't know what Mr. Dean is thinking.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: When he was handing out the assignment, he said that we would be surprised by what we found.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: At this point, I'd be surprised to be surprised.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That... Hurt my head. English, man, English.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: There just doesn't seem to be anything more to Paige. She's completely one-dimensional... And that dimension is snobby.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It took you this long to figure that out? She's just like every rich girl...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Spoiled, stuck up, and stupid. Just like a... Like a bug in dirt.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You might want to work on a new metaphor.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And you might want to work on a new face!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't even know what that means.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Neither do I. So what does she have you doing first? Watching her polish the silver?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh. I think with Paige it's more like watching her ordering `someone else` to polish the silver.
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. I think with Paige it's more like watching her ordering [color=#e23b3b][i]someone else[/i][/color] to polish the silver.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heh. Or ordering you to do it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Actually, I'm supposed to see her in a few minutes for some meeting she has with Taylor and $ZOE about Social Chair. I'd better get going.
Owen starts to pack up his stuff to go. Spencer blocks him.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa, dude, what's the rush?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Like I said, the meeting starts pretty soon.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Pff. If it were me, I'd make `her` come get `you.` That'll teach her a lesson about disrespecting you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Pff. If it were me, I'd make [color=#e23b3b][i]her[/i][/color] come get [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color] That'll teach her a lesson about disrespecting you.

nodes.text: Owen pumps the weight down to his chest and explodes back up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Grrr!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Grrr![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yes! Again!
He easily does a full set of reps before finally setting the barbell back on the rack.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yes! That's what I'm talking about! How'd that feel?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Great!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Never forget! Sometimes you have to just seize the moment!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're not about to tell me YOLO, are you?
Spencer glares at him.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We don't say that around here. Got it?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah. You never heard it from me.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Man, we are going to be so ripped for football!
Owen hesitates... His mind lost in thought. He sits up.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But I can't help thinking that my grandma's right.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude, the anger? The moment? Seize it!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What if all her barbs are just a facade?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Bro! Would you like some tea for girl time?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sorry. My bad.
Owen rests his head back on the bench and lifts the bar off the rack, but he's completely distracted.
He pumps it once and feebly sets it back on the rack.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Weak.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sorry. I'm just unfocused.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We can't afford to be unfocused! Football's coming!
Previously on `Surviving High School...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Previously on [b]Surviving High School...[/b]

nodes.text: Owen and Paige paired up for a school project in which Paige got a firsthand look at Owen's personal life!
At the end of the night, Owen tenderly expressed interest in learning about Paige, but Paige insulted him and stormed out, leaving nothing between them but bad blood.
And now...
You are now playing as Owen.
In the weight room before school starts, Owen prepares himself for a bench press set.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can do this! I can do this!
Spencer leans over him, prepared to spot him.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You ready yet, you flabby mass of lard?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This again? I thought you gave up on the whole angry assistant coach thing.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nah... Still trying. I think I have a real shot at getting the position if I can keep my grades up.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Er, I mean...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't talk back to me! I do the talking, tubby! Now lift!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Chill, Captain Mood Swing. I got enough of that from Paige last night.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I mean, everything was really cool between us, and then she just blew up at me.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Seriously, that chick is a headache with a fancy purse.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: My grandma thinks she was just protecting herself. Like she was feeling vulnerable or something.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No offense, bro, but your grandma's a little out of touch. I mean, she still reads `newspapers.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No offense, bro, but your grandma's a little out of touch. I mean, she still reads [color=#e23b3b][i]newspapers.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not sure who that discredits actually.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All I know is Paige treats you like dirt. Worse than dirt even! She treats you like... Like butt dirt!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Is that a thing?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Maybe?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She didn't mince any words, that's for sure.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude, you have to channel that anger! Lift man! Right now!
Owen thinks of all the insults Paige hurled at him and grabs the barbell.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Lift!
A clock chime strikes, startling them both out of the moment!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What just happened?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I gotta go!
Owen quickly hurries out, back to his truck.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What just happened?
The next day, in Mr. Dean's class...
Paige stands in front of the students. Owen awkwardly watches her but tries not to make eye contact for too long.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I learned from observing Owen that money isn't everything.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sometimes a home-cooked meal and someone to care for you can be nice.
As Paige looks out at the class, Owen sees a genuineness in her eyes. It quickly passes.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But I'll take living in a mansion any day of the week!
The class laughs.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Very good. Owen, you're up.
Owen gets up and stands in front of the class. He thinks about what he's planning on saying... But then his eyes catch Paige's, and he sees the sadness in them.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I was going to talk about how behind her facade of selfishness, there's someone with a lot of pent-up hurt and pain.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But the truth is... That would just cause her more pain. And she's had enough.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The thing about Paige is...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What you see is what you get. I mean, she's right...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Her house is humongous! She's got horses! And servants running around everywhere! It was awesome!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And that's it, Mr. Dean.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: 'It was awesome.' I'll admit I expected more from your end of the assignment.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I call 'em like I see 'em, Mr. Dean.
Owen sits back down in his seat next to Paige. As the next presentation begins, she leans over and whispers to him.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Remember at dinner at your grandma's how I said I was glad for shoes and my awesome life?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, I think after this assignment, I've found one more thing to be glad for.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks, Owie.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Let's not call me that.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Paige, Owen. Can you guys stop fighting for one second? Someone else is presenting.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sorry, Mr. Dean.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Won't happen again.
You have reached the end of `Season 2, Episode 6: Psych Project, Subject: Paige!`
