nodes.text: Thanks, Sam, but no one's going to see it if they don't go inside... At this point, I `want` there to be a ghost in my haunted house, just so `something's` there.
nodes.text_bbcode: Thanks, Sam, but no one's going to see it if they don't go inside... At this point, I [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] there to be a ghost in my haunted house, just so [color=#3b78e2][i]something's[/i][/color] there.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Try not to worry too much. There's a good reason no one's here yet. But they'll come over shortly.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Looks like Howard's coming over. I'll leave you two alone. I'm going to the other side of the gym to check out Paige's carnival.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're abandoning me too, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's just to check out the competition. Besides, I heard she had fancy snacks. I'll steal some food for both of us.
Howard approaches as Sam heads off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE. I managed to get five minutes away from the job. Being a chaperone is harder than it sounds!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is this your haunted house? I can't believe you and Ben made this in two hours! It looks spooky!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm glad you think so. It seems to have scared everyone else away.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's still early. People will come.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what's it like being a 'Parent Chaperone'?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not as much fun as I was led to believe. I have punch duty later, and twice, I've had to tackle a freshman for `inappropriate` dancing.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not as much fun as I was led to believe. I have punch duty later, and twice, I've had to tackle a freshman for [color=#e23b3b][i]inappropriate[/i][/color] dancing.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But if it lets me come to a dance with you, then it's the best job in the world.
He leans down to kiss her. When he pulls away, the look on her face makes him frown.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm worried...

options.label: About you transferring to Centerscore U.
That I won't win Social Chair.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Ahhhhhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahhhhhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: She screams for a full minute before she realizes nothing else has happened.
Instead, Sam stands there, axe in hand, doubled over laughing.
$ZOE ducks!
The axe swings straight over her head!
$ZOE is about to scream for help when she sees Sam, axe in hand, doubled over laughing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha... Nice... Reflexes.
$ZOE doesn't know what to do! She freezes in place and lets out a terrifying scream!
You are now playing as $ZOE.
$ZOE walks alone through the graveyard beside a haunted house, passing by headstone after headstone.
Suddenly, Zoe hears a rustling behind her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's that? Who's there?
She backs up against the tall black gates surrounding the house.
She looks around, but all she sees is the gargoyle statue staring menacingly, its ruby eyes glistening in the night.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hello?
$ZOE moves closer towards the house...
And all at once, $ZOE sees movement in the corner of her eye!
A huge axe swings down on her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The fortune teller did say that the Wheel of Fate turns... Maybe this is what she meant.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's looking great! Everyone's inside, and they're having a great time!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Which is probably why they voted you for Social Chair.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, about that... It seems weird that all voted for me. I'm still confused why I won and not Paige...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I feel like I didn't even do anything to deserve it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, you did. Like I said, you and Ben spent a ton of time making this haunted house special for everyone.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: People really appreciate that. It makes everyone here think of you as a friend.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But they didn't even come over to my side of the gym until the very end...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, that's because a ton of them went over to Paige's side to get snacks before they ran out. You know how excited everyone gets around free food...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But once everyone got what they wanted, they came right on over. See? Everyone likes you! You just scored a `great victory!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But once everyone got what they wanted, they came right on over. See? Everyone likes you! You just scored a [color=#3b78e2][i]great victory![/i][/color]

nodes.text: For a moment, Paige is stunned... Then she glares at $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Paige, I'm sorry--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No. This just proves that no one is `that` nice. Deep down, you're just as mean as all the other popular girls.
nodes.text_bbcode: No. This just proves that no one is [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] nice. Deep down, you're just as mean as all the other popular girls.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't think you're any different.
Paige storms off just as Sam comes up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That was a little harsh, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't mean to say that. She made me snap. Please don't lecture me. I'm embarrassed enough.
Sam shrugs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So how's the haunted house?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Lucky?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... For most of the evening, I thought I didn't stand a chance.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I feel lucky that I have so many good friends who are willing to vote for me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh, you `nice` girls are all the same. So insipid.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh, you [color=#3b78e2][i]nice[/i][/color] girls are all the same. So insipid.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I hope you `enjoy` being Social Chair. May all your dances be total disasters.
nodes.text_bbcode: I hope you [color=#3b78e2][i]enjoy[/i][/color] being Social Chair. May all your dances be total disasters.

nodes.text: Paige storms off as Sam comes up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Was she congratulating you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: More like kind of the opposite.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Anyway, how's the haunted house?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's because... Uh, it's because...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh, you can't finish a sentence! How did you win?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because no one likes you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good bye, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good bye, $ZOE.
$ZOE runs inside, sparing one last look back to see Howard, handsome as ever in his tuxedo and mask, turn away from her for the last time.
$ZOE slips back into the gym where Taylor is standing on stage with a microphone.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hello, everyone! Even though Social Chair is a relatively new position, it's still an important one.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The best Social Chair is not necessarily the person who throws the best parties, but rather the person who is able to pull the school together as a whole.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Without further ado... You all voted, and now it's time to hear who wins!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Your Social Chair for this upcoming year is...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Go, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yay, $ZOE! Woo hoo!
$ZOE rubs at her eyes one more time and adjusts her mask. She joins Taylor up on the front stoop of her haunted house.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And here she is... Your new Social Chair!
The entire gym bursts into enthusiastic applause!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you, everyone! I'm so happy that you voted for me. I promise that this year is going to be so much fun!
Everyone claps as $ZOE steps down. Paige storms up to her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So how did you do it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do what?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't bat your mascara-laden eyelashes at me. I `know` you did something dirty to win. Everyone was on `my` side of the gym for most of the evening!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't bat your mascara-laden eyelashes at me. I [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] you did something dirty to win. Everyone was on [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] side of the gym for most of the evening!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How could they go with you?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't `cheat`, if that's what you mean.
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't [color=#3b78e2][i]cheat[/i][/color], if that's what you mean.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So how did you do it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe it's because...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know what I'll do without you either.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What happens when you can't go back to how you used to be?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You move on, I guess.
Then $ZOE corrects herself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What we `had` was special. A once in a lifetime thing.
nodes.text_bbcode: What we [color=#3b78e2][i]had[/i][/color] was special. A once in a lifetime thing.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yes, it was. And I'll never forget it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The fortune teller did predict a great tragedy...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You should be out there having fun being Social Chair, hanging out with Sam and your cheerleading team, maybe even dating someone who's still in high school...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, don't date anyone. I'm okay with that too.
$ZOE laughs despite the hole in her chest.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Then this is the part where we say our good-byes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And you'll wish me well, and I'll wish you well.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And then... And then we forget about each other.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm never going to forget you, $ZOE. Never.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But the more time I spend here, the more I'm certain that being together isn't good for either of us.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. It's... It's just never been so hard for us before.
$ZOE sighs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want this to happen. I refuse.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't accept what you're saying right now. I can't even believe it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It makes me so angry!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't even want to fight for us? Are you too afraid to even try?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I did try, $ZOE. I came back for you. I was willing to give a lot up for you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not afraid, $ZOE. I'm certain.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The more time I spend here, the more I'm certain that being together isn't good for either of us.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It doesn't matter if I win or lose tonight. I'm just really glad I have good friends like you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Speaking of which...
He points at the gate, and $ZOE sees Ben, Emily, and Sam coming in.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, guys... Welcome back. It's still pretty quiet around here...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not for long! There's a whole bunch of people behind us! They're headed for your house right now!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Looks like everyone just went over to Paige's for the food... Now that it's gone, they want to see you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? Really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's wonderful!
She smiles winningly at Owen who mouths 'I told you so'.
A few minutes later, $ZOE's haunted house is swarming with people!
Students fall in line to visit the haunted house, while others dance in the graveyard!
In one corner...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Did you `see` the Mad Scientist's lab? It has the most fascinating scientific experiments!
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you [color=#e23b3b][i]see[/i][/color] the Mad Scientist's lab? It has the most fascinating scientific experiments!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Nope! I was too busy stuffing my face with $ZOE's awesome cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: This is really a horrific masterpiece.
While in another...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Spencer, I can't believe you guys really got the gargoyle!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Believe it, man! Ghosts chased us out of that cabin!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Is it going to curse me? Is it?
And out on the dance floor...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm dancing on a headstone! Look at me! I'm dancing on a headstone!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Let's go in again... We can make out in that spooky hall of mirrors!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, I think that gargoyle is staring at me funny...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: This house is `spooky!` Great job, $ZOE!
nodes.text_bbcode: This house is [color=#3b78e2][i]spooky![/i][/color] Great job, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks!
At that moment, someone taps $ZOE on her shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard! I'm so glad you're here!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was having the worst time, and I couldn't find you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I think everything's going to work out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm happy for you... But do you think we can get a moment to talk?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, sure...
$ZOE looks to her haunted house. She catches Sam's eye and points to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Go have your moment. Ben and I will take care of things here!
Howard takes her hand, and they walk outside.
Outside in the cool night air...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm glad you finally got some time off! I didn't think I was ever going to get to see you...
$ZOE trails off when she sees the grim look on Howard's face.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard? What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE... I think...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think we should break up.
$ZOE feels as though she's been punched in the gut.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why? What changed in the last hour?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I had a run-in with Nate...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no. What did he say?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A bunch of stuff that pissed me off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But also some things that made me think about what I was doing and why we were getting back together.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't really belong in your world.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, that's not true. If you're talking about high school... Everyone still remembers and loves you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's true that I still have friends here, but... I don't feel like it's where I'm supposed to be.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I mean, I can't even spend time with you at a dance! And that meant not being able to be by your side when you needed me the most.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...But things worked out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Only because you have good friends like Owen. He did what I couldn't.
Howard looks down. Then he takes both of $ZOE's hands.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, I love you so much, and I don't regret any of the time we had together.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I think I was wrong to come back.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... You weren't. You wanted us to be together. You thought we were meant to be.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And maybe we are. But not right now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So this is it then?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're really good at cheering me up.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm glad. You know that I'll always be here for you, right?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know.
And in that moment, $ZOE suddenly feels warm, content, and safe...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We used to be such good friends. What happened?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, we haven't really had the chance to talk ever since...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ever since?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ever since Howard came back. You've been... Busy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... Right. I guess it was kind of my fault we got out of touch...
And in that moment, $ZOE suddenly feels guilty for not spending as much time with Owen...
You are now playing as $ZOE.
Meanwhile, $ZOE sits in front of her house with Owen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You didn't have to come and sit with me, you know.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, I'm just happy I get to talk to you. Of course, I hope you don't mind my saying that it seems pretty `dead` around here.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, I'm just happy I get to talk to you. Of course, I hope you don't mind my saying that it seems pretty [color=#e23b3b][i]dead[/i][/color] around here.

nodes.text: $ZOE groans.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you think of that just now, or were you waiting all evening to say that?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just something I thought of in the moment.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... How's it going?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Awful.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Would it help if I said that `I want to suck your blood?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Would it help if I said that [color=#e23b3b][i]I want to suck your blood?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha. I like my blood where it is, thanks.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Then how about we just sit and talk?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Owen... This entire night's a mess. Everyone is on Paige's side of the gym. I don't think I have a shot at winning Social Chair now.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The night's not over yet. You shouldn't give up. Ever.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're an amazing person. You're always nice to people, and you're always there for your friends.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, you helped me pull my life together. I can't be the first person you've helped. And people don't forget that kind of thing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen...

options.label: That makes me feel a lot better.

nodes.text: He resists the urge to hit Nate, forcing his hands down by his side.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A Kingston King wouldn't hit a high school kid. Even a punk high school kid who's asking for it.
Howard turns away from him.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Where are you going? You're not going to fight?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not going to start anything with you. Believe me, it'd be too easy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now I'm going to go into the dance and comfort `my girlfriend.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now I'm going to go into the dance and comfort [color=#e23b3b][i]my girlfriend.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And you're not going to follow.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Or else what?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Or else I do what an actual chaperone would do and have security haul you out for violence on school grounds.
Howard walks past Nate. Nate makes no move to stop him.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I can ruin you! I know that you lied!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `'News flash'`... So does she.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]'News flash'[/i][/color]... So does she.

nodes.text: Howard walks up to the doors. Through the glass, he can see $ZOE sitting on the steps of the haunted house with Owen.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What was I thinking? I spent so much time justifying why I belong here that I couldn't even be there for Zoe...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now it feels like I'm too late...
Howard punches Nate!
The blow makes Nate reel for a second...
Then he recovers, launching himself at Howard and pushing him back!
They burst through the doors of the gymnasium and straight into $ZOE's haunted house!
Nate and Howard barrel into a line of fake headstones and knock down the fake tree in the front!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no! My house!
Nate and Howard roll in the fake dirt, taking down fake cobwebs and strings of scary lights.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm. Taking. You. `Down!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm. Taking. You. [color=#e23b3b][i]Down![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Never!
Nate and Howard tussle for several more minutes until they're both suddenly drenched with punch!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What just happened?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Ugh! What did you do?!
They both look up to see $ZOE with a now empty punch bowl.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Stop it! Both of you!
Howard and Nate survey what they've done. The front yard of $ZOE's haunted house is a mess.
The tree has been completely uprooted, part of the house's facade has been ripped away, and the graveyard now lies in ruins.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's... It's ruined!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Zoe...
Howard stands up and puts an arm around her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm really sorry about what happened.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everything that Ben and I built... It's all ruined!
$ZOE breaks away from Howard and runs towards the girls' restroom.
Howard glares at Nate.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look what you've done!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I wasn't the only one rolling around in the graveyard, buddy.
At that moment, a police officer comes up to both of them.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You two! Stop right there!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We weren't moving...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: A likely story... You two are coming with me.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: My father is the `mayor`--
nodes.text_bbcode: My father is the [color=#e23b3b][i]mayor[/i][/color]--

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Your father could be a pig, but I'm still hauling you down to the station. Come on.
As Monte leads Howard and Nate out of the gym, Howard feels his stomach sink, knowing he's let $ZOE down...
One thing's for sure...
Howard has failed.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE makes her own choices, and no amount of manipulation is going to make her like you any more.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: She might like me better if I told her that her boyfriend lied to her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You can't fool me. I know everything that's going on in this school.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right. Fine. What are you going to tell $ZOE I lied about?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: That there is no Vernal Equinox! You're here because you couldn't take college life!
Howard stares at him, then starts laughing.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You don't think I'm serious?
Nate shoves Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You wanna go, man? I'll go! I could take you in a heartbeat!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You talk a big game... But you have `no` idea who you're messing with...
nodes.text_bbcode: You talk a big game... But you have [color=#e23b3b][i]no[/i][/color] idea who you're messing with...

nodes.text: Howard stares down Nate.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yeah, I do. I'm dealing with a washed-up, washed-out college guy who's pathetically trying to cling to the glory of his high school days.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Well, news flash: those days are `over.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, news flash: those days are [color=#e23b3b][i]over.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard is all at once filled with the overwhelming urge to punch Nate's face in.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: $ZOE's a good girl.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And I want to protect her because she's my friend.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Bull. All you're interested in is getting rid of me, so that you can get to her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But you're doing it wrong.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And it just rankles you that I used to be the football captain, and everyone likes me better.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're `jealous.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're [color=#e23b3b][i]jealous.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Jealous?! Of you? Yeah right!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Who is anyone going to remember more: the `popular` football captain or the guy who got them to the State Championships?
nodes.text_bbcode: Who is anyone going to remember more: the [color=#e23b3b][i]popular[/i][/color] football captain or the guy who got them to the State Championships?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Then what do you want?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I want to protect $ZOE.
$ZOE walks back to her side to find that her haunted house is still empty.
Sam, Howard, and Ben are nowhere to be seen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not even my closest friends are here... What now?
$ZOE sits on top of a headstone, trying to keep from tearing up.
You are now playing as Howard.
In the school cafeteria, Howard helps Mr. Russell collect cups and supplies for the dance's snack table.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Thanks for helping, Howard. It's nice to see a different face around here. It's usually just the same old staff.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's fine, Mr. Russell.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Please, it's Melville. Or Mel.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's fine, Mel. I'm actually enjoying myself. I didn't know that Ms. Pliny almost took the same major as me when she was in college.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Or that you and Alicia's sister got married!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Funny how it's not until after high school that you realize teachers have lives outside the classroom.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: I admit, I was surprised to see you around again. Aren't you supposed to be at Kingston?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm just on a break.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: That's good. You were always bright. When I heard you were majoring in the sciences, I was impressed.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: You'll be in an excellent position when you finish Kingston's program. It's the top rated in the country.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: But don't listen to me ramble on. Surely you must have something better to do then hang out back here on a Saturday night.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, my girlfriend's out there. I've been trying to see her all evening.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Ah. That must be it. I don't need you to set out more cups. You go out there and have fun.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's weird how I can talk with Mr. Russell like that. It's like we're equals or something...
Howard rushes towards the gym. Through the door's glass panel, he can see $ZOE sitting in front of her attraction, her head buried in her hands.
He is almost through the doors when...
Nate appears in front of him.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Where do you think you're going?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nate?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Listen, I don't want to hassle you, but technically, students aren't supposed to be back here.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Neither are recent high school graduates, but here you are.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. Here I am. Now can I get by?
Howard tries to step around, but Nate blocks his path.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you want, Nate?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: A faster car, a vacation house in Hawaii, and the chance to play football professionally...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: But what I want the most is for you to disappear.
Howard stares Nate down before responding.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know what it is you have against me, but I'm not the guy you should be trying to pick a fight with.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Am I? You're the all-star football player and seemingly good guy that swooped in to date the nicest girl in school...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Aren't you?
And then it clicks for Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I get what this is. You're taking your anger out on me because...

options.label: You hate being in my shadow.

nodes.text: A chill bites at the back of her neck. She tries to bundle up even more, but it doesn't help much.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Look, you're freezing, so I'm just going to come right out and say it because it's on both of our minds...
And for the next hour, they talk like old friends...
They talk of life at Kingston and life at Twin Branches...
Of Howard's college courses and of $ZOE's school life...
Until at last, the evening winds down...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about Twin Branches do you miss the most?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's hard to say... I definitely miss my family...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My mom, my dad... Kay, Kel, and Kara...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I've really missed you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You have?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, you were such a big part of my life... And we were a really great team.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It was hard for me to move forward...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I had to force myself to.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... Me too.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I'm glad we can still talk... The way we used to.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Anyway, it's getting late... I should go.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll walk you out.
They exit into the parking lot.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'd like to hang out with you again. What are you doing for lunch tomorrow?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The usual... I'll be in the cafeteria.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Where the meat is so scary that they call it 'mystery mystery'...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How about I take you out for lunch? I can pick you up, we'll grab something quick, and I'll get you back before seventh period.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wouldn't mind dropping by the school anyway.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, okay! Sure!
They stop by her car.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Zoe, it's... It's really good to see you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's really good to see you too.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll pick you up at noon?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yep.
They stare at one another.
His phone vibrates again with another text from Emily.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: ur coming here? i'll try to stall!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's my girl!

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Joke? Did u sit on a scone? i dont get it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just... Hang on!
Ben darts left and...
...Cuts through the library!
Up ahead, two nerds sit on either side of a long table that blocks his path!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know about you, Kev, but this section on chemistry is confounding!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: No joke.
Ben reaches the table and...
Emily's father catches Ben with a stern gaze.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: What are you doing here, Ben? Shouldn't you be in class?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I'd hate to have you lie to me after our delightful dinner the other day...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...I ditched it. To be honest, I really wanted to see your daughter before she goes.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Hmph. I can't fault your devotion. Say what you need to say and head on back to class.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks.
Cameron extends an arm down and pulls Emily up.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Didn't Jane or Hannah offer to help?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That would be the right thing to do.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But they're not exactly friends with me right now.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Thanks, by the way...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So much for the team getting to the top together, right?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I guess our chemistry's off.
Cameron's eyes meet hers and for a second, she's completely and utterly caught by them.
Around them, the students chatter excitedly!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: $ZOE's definitely my top pick!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love her cupcakes! Which means I love her!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: She's like a celebrity, and `celebrities` always win! Social Chair is hers!
nodes.text_bbcode: She's like a celebrity, and [color=#3b78e2][i]celebrities[/i][/color] always win! Social Chair is hers!

nodes.text: Nearby, Paige looks on, a disgusted expression on her face.
At the front, Taylor walks $ZOE offstage.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All right, $ZOE. The endorsement's just the beginning.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you're going to be Social Chair, you'll have to do a lot more. Your duties aren't just cupcakes and dunk tanks.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You'll have to be, like, responsible. In other words, I have a really boring task for you. I'm trusting you with the budget for the Halloween Dance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm so... So...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Disappointed? Mind-numbingly bored?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Excited!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're the only person I know who'd be excited to do this.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course! But just one question...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do I make a budget?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I have a folder here with all the information. We have a set amount of money for the dance.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Figure out how much you want us to put into decorations, food, and other stuff like that.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Do not go over budget.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Do not go over budget.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can do that! Don't worry, Taylor, I know how to...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Correct me if I'm wrong, but isn't the point of this assignment for you to actually learn something about me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Easy there, Caveman. I think I already know enough.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You know that I eat in the cafeteria and that I lift weights in the weight room. Not what Mr. Dean had in mind.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, I know a lot more than that. I know you're afraid of what I'm going to think of you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Afraid? Pfft. I'm not--
Paige gives him an 'Oh really?' look.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay... Maybe I care what you think `a little.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay... Maybe I care what you think [color=#e23b3b][i]a little.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And I know why you rushed me out of that cafeteria.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You were being really mean to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on! $ZOE can hold her own against a mean girl. You rushed me out of there because you're jealous of Howard.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? That's not--
Paige gives Owen the same look.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, you got me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow. Psych class is `way` easy. If I don't get an 'A' on this, something is totally wrong.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow. Psych class is [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] easy. If I don't get an 'A' on this, something is totally wrong.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So, I guess you were right. You do already know me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Actually, that's not completely true. There's still one thing I don't understand at all.
Owen towels off the bench.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why `$ZOE?` I mean, could she `be` any more boring and drab? She's completely thrift.
nodes.text_bbcode: Why [color=#3b78e2][i]$ZOE?[/i][/color] I mean, could she [color=#3b78e2][i]be[/i][/color] any more boring and drab? She's completely thrift.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thrift?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Have you seen her clothes? They don't even come from a designer line I've heard of.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's not something I care about... Or any guy for that matter.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever. Look, all I'm saying is that $ZOE's been head over hand-me-down heels for Howard since forever.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: A guy like you can't compete. Maybe if you had money...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why do you care?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't. I just hate $ZOE. It's bad enough having one good guy go after her, let alone...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Aha! I see what's going on here.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?

options.label: You have a crush on me!
You're jealous of all the attention $ZOE's getting!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I thought your mom was taking us.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't worry about it.
Outside the mall, Owen waits with Paige while a valet brings her car around. Her arms are laden with shopping bags.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do you do this `every` Monday?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you do this [color=#e23b3b][i]every[/i][/color] Monday?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I like to shop. Deal with it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I meant go to that dance class...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes. Why?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No reason. It just... Surprised me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What's so surprising about me dancing?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know. I never pegged you as someone who...

nodes.prompt: I never pegged you as someone who...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I never pegged you as someone who...

nodes.text: $ZOE herds Sam into the mad scientist's laboratory...
$ZOE pulls Sam down a pitch black hallway.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're going to have to do a lot better than a dark hallway to get me--

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, welcome to the dance room!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The what now?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought it'd be cool to make a dance floor out of a graveyard. I'll be blasting music out here. It'll be fun!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Cool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what do you think of the house?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't think you had it in you, but this is awesome!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, Ben brought all the cool props in. I couldn't have done it without his help.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You did come up with a lot of the ideas.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It was a team effort.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've seen better...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? It's not `bad!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What? It's not [color=#3b78e2][i]bad![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It doesn't affect me, but I'm sure it'll scare the pants off everyone else!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's good enough, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's only one thing I'd add that would take it from that-was-kind-of-scary frightening to keep-me-up-at-night frightening.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And what's that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: A gargoyle. And not just `any` gargoyle... The one from the old cabin in the woods!
nodes.text_bbcode: A gargoyle. And not just [color=#e23b3b][i]any[/i][/color] gargoyle... The one from the old cabin in the woods!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah! That thing freaked everyone out last night. We `have` to get it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! That thing freaked everyone out last night. We [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to get it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It would be awesome, but I wouldn't be able to do it. I have that dinner thing with Howard's family that I can't miss.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And they're locking the gym up until the dance, so we couldn't do it tomorrow afternoon either.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, guys...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But the haunted house looks great! Thanks for all your help, Ben. I'll see you at the dance tomorrow!
As $ZOE leaves, Ben turns to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, `$ZOE` can't steal the statue...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#e23b3b][i]$ZOE[/i][/color] can't steal the statue...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean `we` can't...
nodes.text_bbcode: But that doesn't mean [color=#e23b3b][i]we[/i][/color] can't...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm in.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Call Spencer. We're going to need his truck.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I mean, come on, look at your haunted house! You just threw it together at the last minute!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I may have put it together quickly, but I've made sure that people will enjoy it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's cute that you think that'll make a difference. Too bad no one will be there. They don't even need to go to your side to see how bad it is.
Paige points at some students who have already started filling out the ballot forms on computers near the attractions.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That doesn't prove anything.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes, it does. It proves that I'm going to win, and I just can't `wait` until the announcement ceremony.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, it does. It proves that I'm going to win, and I just can't [color=#3b78e2][i]wait[/i][/color] until the announcement ceremony.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'll see what happens.
$ZOE strides away as confidently as she can.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This doesn't mean that Paige is going to win!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...I hope.
She ducks into the nearest tent, so Paige won't see that she's upset.
Inside, $ZOE is greeted with the smell of strong incense and burning wax.
An older woman in robes sits at a table with a crystal ball and a stack of brightly painted cards in front of her.

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: Good evening. I am Madame Fortuna, the fortune teller.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, uh, sorry... I didn't mean to bother you!

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: You are not. I was expecting you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You were?

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: Please, have a seat.
$ZOE reluctantly sits down at the table.

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: You are carrying a lot of worry with you. I sense there is trouble in your romantic and social life...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do you know?

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: Because you are a teenager.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... That's not really a fortune...

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: No, merely an observation. But perhaps a reading will lend you some insight into how your future will develop...
Madame Fortuna takes her deck, shuffles it, and draws the first three cards off the top.

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: These are the two cards that have responded to your spiritual energy.

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: Choose one. It will tell you what your immediate future holds...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I choose the card...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I didn't think she meant this.
$ZOE can't hold it in any longer. Tears run down her face.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE...
He holds his arms out, and she steps into his embrace. They hold each other for a while, neither wanting to be the first to pull away.
And then the moment ends when the door to the gym bursts open, and Sam walks out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE! You've got to get in here quick! They're announcing the Social Chair...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I think you've got a shot!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll... I'll be there in a second!
Sam ducks back inside. $ZOE starts wiping the tears away from her cheeks and sniffles hard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't look like a mess, do I?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You always look beautiful to me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard... Are we... Are we ever going to see each other again?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not for a while. But maybe someday.
Then he leans down and kisses her tenderly. She savors the moment as if it's their last kiss in the world...
Because somewhere deep in $ZOE's crumbling heart, she knows it is.
Howard pulls away, and they face each other for the last time.

options.label: I don't know what I'll do without you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Never mind... Come on, let's go to the haunted house and party it up!
You have reached the end of `The Halloween Dance, Part 2.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]The Halloween Dance, Part 2.[/b]

options.label: Episode Two: Swim Team Retreat, Part 1
Episode Three: Swim Team Retreat, Part 2
Episode Five: Psych Project, Subject: Owen
Episode Six: Psych Project, Subject: Paige
Episode Seven: The Halloween Dance, Part 1
Episode Eight: The Halloween Dance, Part 2

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, uh... Well, there are girls at Kingston...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can only imagine...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I haven't met any girl worth spending time with...
Howard looks at $ZOE with an emotion she can't identify.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What about you? Have you started dating anyone?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um...
$ZOE's mind wanders to the football field an hour earlier...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So $ZOE, now that this is all over...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do you think we could finally get some time to just hang out together?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Because I'd really like to get to know you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE?
$ZOE focuses on Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, uh... No, I haven't...

options.label: There's no one I'm interested in.
I've been too busy to date.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: All right! It's getting dark. Everyone get in your tents in half an hour for bed.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What? But it's not even night yet!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You're going to want a good night's sleep. We'll be up early tomorrow for something a lot bigger than tents and trust falls.
As the swimmers unpack their things from the bus, Emily approaches Jane.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey, Jane.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: What do `you` want?
nodes.text_bbcode: What do [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] want?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I just wanted to clear the air between us. I think you've got the wrong impression about me.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Oh, I think I've got exactly the `right` impression about you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I think I've got exactly the [color=#3b78e2][i]right[/i][/color] impression about you.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: You're dating Ben and you're not interested in Cameron. In fact, you've done everything you can to give Cameron the cold shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's... Exactly right.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I know it is.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So then, why does it feel like you're really mad at me?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Because I `am` mad at you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Because I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] mad at you.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: If I haven't done anything wrong, why are you mad at me?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Well, you haven't done anything wrong `yet.` But you `will.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you haven't done anything wrong [color=#3b78e2][i]yet.[/i][/color] But you [color=#3b78e2][i]will.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You're mad at me for something I haven't even done yet?!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Think about it. I was in the same spot you're in now.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I mean, I `hated` Cameron... The idea of touching him was like touching a dirty garbage rat.
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, I [color=#3b78e2][i]hated[/i][/color] Cameron... The idea of touching him was like touching a dirty garbage rat.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh... Ew.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: But then we ended up making out like a... Like a pair of frisky rabbits.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Enough with the animal imagery, Jane! TMI!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Deal with it.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I don't understand. If you didn't like him, why hook up with him?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Because he surprised me. I mean, he actually knew things about the feminist movement!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: He's like the first guy I ever actually had a meaningful conversation with!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Plus, he's got this way of looking at you that is impossible to resist.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So I've heard.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Anyway, I know how strong-willed `I` am. And if I couldn't resist Cameron, then you don't stand a chance.
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, I know how strong-willed [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] am. And if I couldn't resist Cameron, then you don't stand a chance.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: So, I guess what I'm saying is that I'm mad at `future Emily.`
nodes.text_bbcode: So, I guess what I'm saying is that I'm mad at [color=#3b78e2][i]future Emily.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well then...
Cameron extends an arm down and pulls Emily up.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Didn't Jane or Hannah offer to help?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That would be the right thing to do.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But they're not exactly friends with me right now.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Thanks, by the way...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So much for the team getting to the top together, right?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I guess our chemistry's off.
Cameron's eyes meet hers and for a second, she's completely and utterly caught by them.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm fine. I could just use a little help, that's all.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Emily? Are you okay?
You are now playing as Hannah.
The rest of the swimmers have all reached the top of Mount Collins and are huddled together underneath a tarp erected by Coach Kessler.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'm all wet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Join the party...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: The `I'm miserable because I'm stuck in a storm on top of a mountain` party.
nodes.text_bbcode: The [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm miserable because I'm stuck in a storm on top of a mountain[/i][/color] party.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No offense, but I'm busy! I'd rather be here with you guys!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: This sucks.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: It sucks even worse for Emily and Cameron... They're still out there...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Shut up, Jane.
Coach Kessler paces in front of them while trying to place a phone call. After a few rings, he slams his phone shut.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Great! No reception!
The rain pours down over him, his face red with anger as he glares at the swimmers.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: How come none of you know where my daughter is?!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You were `supposed` to get to the top as a team! How hard is it to stick together?!
nodes.text_bbcode: You were [color=#e23b3b][i]supposed[/i][/color] to get to the top as a team! How hard is it to stick together?!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Now she's out there in a complete downpour!
He stops in front of Hannah and Jane!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You two! You made it to the top last! Why wasn't she with you?!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And you'd better tell the truth, or I'll know.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Uh...
Hannah clears her throat.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'm not going to let Jane get us into trouble. And I'm definitely not going to tell Coach the truth!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: There's no telling how mad he'd get!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Emily wasn't with us because...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whatever... It doesn't matter! If it ends in 'day', I'm happy!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't argue with that. So, where `is` $ZOE?
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't argue with that. So, where [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Where do you think? She's probably off spit-swapping with Mr. Perfect right now...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Their faces all mashed up against each other like a couple of manatees.
Owen, thinking about $ZOE and Howard together, feels a rush of jealousy!
He steps outside, rounds the corner behind the school for a breather...
And bumps right into $ZOE and Howard mid-makeout session!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen!
$ZOE separates from Howard.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Awkward!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, sorry... I didn't see tongue... Er! I didn't see `you` there.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, sorry... I didn't see tongue... Er! I didn't see [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] there.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I haven't seen you much at all since the fundraiser...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Been real busy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Cool.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Cool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Cool.
Owen kicks at a piece of trash on the ground.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So...

options.label: How's the Social Chair thing going?

nodes.text: After Owen and Paige get her some food, they sit back down at the Center Table.
Paige takes in her surroundings, noticing $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Interesting! $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, hi, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Listen, when you have time, could you advise me on whether my food purchases were economical today?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, wait, never mind. You're not very good at `budgets` are you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, wait, never mind. You're not very good at [color=#3b78e2][i]budgets[/i][/color] are you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's it like...
Howard resists!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'Patience and restraint are the marks of a wise man'... If there's anything I learned from fencing at Kingston, it's that punching Nate isn't going to do either of us good.
...But that doesn't stop Nate from talking.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You know, you don't even belong here. Even if $ZOE doesn't see what's going on, I do.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You two shouldn't even be together. You're keeping her from moving on and enjoying all the high school she has left.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You're just holding her back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's not true. Our relationship is once-in-a-lifetime, and I'm not letting that go.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: What relationship? You can't even be with her right now! You're back here, chatting it up with the teachers, getting cups!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Pathetic.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right. Because you're not. Following her around like a puppy, spying on her, picking a fight with the guy she's dating...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She's avoiding you. You're never going to win a girl like $ZOE.
Nate lunges forward to punch Howard!
Howard neatly steps around Nate, dodging the blow and causing Nate to charge straight into the lockers!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Unnhhh...
While Nate recovers, Howard sees the perfect opportunity to take him down...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But seriously... I'm on a break.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wouldn't your school break be a little later? Like, around Thanksgiving?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, it's Kingston's way of celebrating the, uh... Vernal Equinox.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's kind of weird... But hey. East Coast schools, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... Those East Coast schools are all so... Strange?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ha ha... I just meant that Kingston has peculiar traditions.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I bet...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Like, there's one legend in the school...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: About this `secret` society that all the elite members become part of.
nodes.text_bbcode: About this [color=#e23b3b][i]secret[/i][/color] society that all the elite members become part of.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Cool!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: How much to dunk Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $10 for two balloons!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Done!
Spencer climbs into the dunk seat, and Nicole throws one balloon...
It misses!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You throw like a girl!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You're not getting away with an insult as sad as `that!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're not getting away with an insult as sad as [color=#3b78e2][i]that![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nicole throws the balloon at the target!
`Kersploosh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Kersploosh![/b]

nodes.text: The crowd cheers as Spencer falls!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Whoo! Go, Nicole, go!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who's up next?
And for the rest of the afternoon, $ZOE and Howard receive a steady stream of customers...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Let's see if I can knock Jacob off his high horse!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Whoa!
`Kersploosh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Kersploosh![/b]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who wants to dunk Phil?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: My pleasure!
`Kersploosh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Kersploosh![/b]

nodes.text: An hour later, the fundraiser winds down, and Taylor comes up to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I had Brendan do some calculations... And congratulations! You're the one who's made the most money!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But what about Paige and her cupcakes?
Paige stands at her booth, yelling angrily at the people in her booth.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Who can't afford a cupcake? I lowered the price to five hundred!

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Still too steep for my blood...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Seriously. We're `actresses,` not banks.
nodes.text_bbcode: Seriously. We're [color=#3b78e2][i]actresses,[/i][/color] not banks.

nodes.text: Paige looks over and sees her two friends from Monarch Prep come up.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Great! People with money! Give me a thousand dollars, and I'll give you this delicious cupcake...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Dollars? Can you take credit?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Yeah, I didn't bring any cash.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do you `mean` you didn't bring any cash? I don't have anything to swipe your credit cards with!
nodes.text_bbcode: What do you [color=#3b78e2][i]mean[/i][/color] you didn't bring any cash? I don't have anything to swipe your credit cards with!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Don't look at me. I haven't touched paper money in five years...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What about `you`, Prissy?
nodes.text_bbcode: What about [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color], Prissy?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You think I just carry a thousand dollars on me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes! You did that one time you bought that Charmani dress!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: That was an emergency!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh, I was really counting on you two!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, as you can see, Paige has some problems of her own...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So from here on out... I give you the full support of my Presidency.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Taylor!
As $ZOE skips away, she runs right into Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Looks like things really came together, huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wouldn't have been able to do it without your idea.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you so much.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No problem... But I wasn't the one who brought the dunk tank.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard's always been good at pulling stuff together...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Isn't he great?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah. A real stand-up guy.
$ZOE notices Howard packing up the truck.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Owen, but I have to catch Howard before he leaves...
$ZOE taps Howard on the shoulder. When he turns to her, she gives him a big hug!
As she leans back to smile up at him, Owen walks away.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, what was that for?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, thank you so much for bringing this over.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wouldn't have raised any money without your help...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We really are a `great` team...
nodes.text_bbcode: We really are a [color=#3b78e2][i]great[/i][/color] team...

nodes.text: $ZOE looks down at the ground, but Howard catches her chin and tips it up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, I would've done this for you any day. I...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm still in love with you.
You have reached the end of `Howard's Return.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Howard's Return.[/b]

nodes.text: The next afternoon, $ZOE stands in front of her table at the fundraiser.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come play balloon toss!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Only $5 for two balloons!
People stop to look at the barrel of water balloons, but pass them up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No one wants to try to win a stuffed animal?
Nearby, Paige's bakery booth is filled with interested people.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I had all these shipped overnight from the finest patisserie in Paris.

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: How divine!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It's like being in France!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And these cupcakes over here were made with the most expensive chocolate in Switzerland...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It `smells` like money...
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#3b78e2][i]smells[/i][/color] like money...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And `these` cupcakes are dusted with gold...
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]these[/i][/color] cupcakes are dusted with gold...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh! Shiny!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: How much?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: One cupcake for $1000!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If Paige is selling cupcakes at those rates, she'll beat me easily!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe I should raise my prices...
Owen approaches $ZOE's booth.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm stepping right up... What do I get to do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: For the fine rate of $5, you get two water balloons and two tries to peg one of the targets over there...
$ZOE points at the brightly colored, hand-painted targets.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If you hit one, you can win a stuffed animal.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: $ZOE, this looks great. You must have worked really hard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, but water balloons aren't nearly as enticing as gold-encrusted cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's crazy! If anything, gold is the last thing I want to be putting into my mouth...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And yet...
$ZOE waves a hand at her empty booth.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The only person who's tried is Amanda, and she screamed when she thought she killed a stuffed animal by mistake...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You know what you need?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A miracle?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: A new spin! A way to attract people over... You should...
But Owen's suggestion dies when a truck with a large dunk tank rumbles onto the field and parks right next to $ZOE's booth!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's going on?
Howard jumps down from the truck bed and gestures to the dunk tank.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Your water balloon concept got me thinking about crazy water stuff.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And then I remembered my friends at Centerscore U telling me how they'd used a dunk tank at their last frat party.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It looks brand new!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I had to wash it `seven` times... You `really` don't want to know why...
nodes.text_bbcode: I had to wash it [color=#e23b3b][i]seven[/i][/color] times... You [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] don't want to know why...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But it's all ready to go.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who am I going to dunk though? There's only one of me...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I made a few calls. You're going to have a fleet of State Champions to dunk...
Some of the football team comes over.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I can't wait...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: This will be fun!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dunk tank! Dunk tank!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! This is amazing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you! Thank you! Thank you! People will `love` this!
nodes.text_bbcode: Thank you! Thank you! Thank you! People will [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] this!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just need to get them here...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, you're a cheerleader... And now you have something to cheer about!
$ZOE steps up and yells...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Are you going to fall or what?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hannah's not going to let me hurt myself, no matter how mad she is... Right?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: On the other hand, my dad will be a new level of furious if I refuse to participate!
Emily sighs, closes her eyes, and folds her arms over her body...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'll do something.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Of course she will. You just have to trust her.
Hannah closes her eyes, folds her arms over her body, and leans back, falling toward Emily!
Cameron settles down inside the cave. Emily peers inside... There's barely enough room for her.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Besides, it might be the only dry spot around here for miles.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hey, Emily, you okay?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm fine, I'm just... Still rattled by what happened back there...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Any sign of the rest of the swim team?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: No, and it's getting dark fast... We're going to have to spend the night here.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Wow. The cave is a lot smaller than I thought it would be. I don't think both of us can fit in that small space...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I know it's not a palace, but it's all we've got.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: What was that?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Come on!
Emily scrambles out of the cave!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Em! Wait!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: There's no time! Someone could be in trouble!
Emily runs in the direction of the screaming, away from the ledge, Cameron chasing behind her.

nodes.speaker: Scream
nodes.text: Heeeeeeeeelp! Somebody!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I can't see anything!
Emily trips over a rock, slips on the other side, and scrapes her leg against a jagged branch.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Be careful, Em!
Emily doesn't stop running, weaving along a path, and scrambling around a large boulder...
Another scream rings out from above!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: `Heeeeeelp!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Heeeeeelp![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Above, Hannah is hugging a rocky cliff face twenty feet off the ground!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Who's down there? Help! Help!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's me, Hannah! It's Emily.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Oh no! No! No! No! No! `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no! No! No! No! No! [color=#3b78e2][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Is Cameron with you? I want Cameron.

nodes.speaker: Distant Voice
nodes.text: Help! Somebody help!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: That sounds like Jane! I'll go find her! You help Hannah!
Cameron runs off in the direction of Jane's calls for help.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Wait! Switch roles! Don't leave me!
Emily rolls her eyes and walks to the spot underneath Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Cameron? Cameron? Are you there?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's just me, Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'm stuck.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I noticed.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What, um, what happens now?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You can't climb back up?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: No, genius! If I could climb back up then I wouldn't be asking for help, would I?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I think if you're going to be asking for help, you probably shouldn't insult the person trying to help you.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Fine. So what do I do?
Emily thinks about it for a moment and realizes Hannah's only option. She sighs...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: The trust fall.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: The trust fall. You're going to have to close your eyes, fall back, and I'll catch you.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You're crazy! It's called the `trust` fall. If you think I trust you after I abandoned you, think again!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're crazy! It's called the [color=#3b78e2][i]trust[/i][/color] fall. If you think I trust you after I abandoned you, think again!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Besides, if the situation were reversed, I would never trust me to catch you!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well...
Emily scoots over so her shoulder touches Cameron's.
He opens up his jacket, and she puts her arms around him, instantly feeling the warmth of his body.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: How are you this warm?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I've always been this way. When it's cold, it's a blessing. When it's warm, it's a curse.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Life of a hot guy.
Emily frowns up at him.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Life of a warm guy?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, I appreciate it now.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: So, where'd you learn this cavewoman fire stuff?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: From my dad... And Sara. We used to come out to the woods, and my dad would teach us all kinds of survival techniques.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: That's pretty cool... I mean, it always seems like he cares about you and that he cared about Sara... Fiercely.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Very` fiercely.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Very[/i][/color] fiercely.

nodes.text: Cameron takes a deep breath...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm going to tell you what I meant to tell you before.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You sure?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Go ahead...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Okay... Here goes...
Cameron takes another big breath, then...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I used to have a pretty big crush on your sister.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: She was everything I wanted in a girlfriend, but I was too stupid to do anything about it. Too much pride.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: We used to talk... Or I used to talk to her. She wanted nothing to do with me. Just like you.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sisters, remember?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: How could I forget? You look just like her.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Ever since Sara passed, I've felt... I `feel`... Responsible for you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ever since Sara passed, I've felt... I [color=#e23b3b][i]feel[/i][/color]... Responsible for you.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What?
Cameron puts his arm tightly around Emily.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I haven't been flirting with you, Emily. It's not about that. It's different and deeper and... And more.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm not going to let anything bad happen to you...
Outside the cave, the rain pours down into the ravine far below.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: This doesn't count, by the way.
Emily laughs...
She feels relieved, as if for the first time she doesn't have a burden she didn't know she was carrying...
It's as if her grief isn't alone...
A sudden scream pierces the air!

nodes.speaker: Scream
nodes.text: Heeeeeeeeelp!
You are now playing as $ZOE.
Meanwhile...
Howard and $ZOE walk into the amusement park.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was surprised to see an amusement park in town.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, they built it right after you left for college.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Have you been here yet?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No. It's my first time coming here!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Then we'll make sure you have a good time.
He takes her hand, and the touch feels foreign to her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We used to be so close. Why does it feel weird now?
She grips Howard's hand tighter.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Where do you want to go first?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'd like to try my hand at some real carnival games...
They step up to a booth where three milk bottles are stacked into a triangle. Howard tosses $ZOE a softball.

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Step right up! Step right up! First one to knock all the bottles down gets a huge prize!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: First one's on me. Let's see that arm! Throw it low!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right! I'll win something you'll be proud to take home to your parents...
$ZOE winds up and throws the ball at the...

nodes.prompt: How do you throw the ball?

menu.title: Choose quickly!
menu.text: How do you throw the ball?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait... Where's `my` food?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... Where's [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] food?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You have to get it yourself. That's how cafeterias work.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh no. I'm not doing that. Go get it for me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, I'm not your servant.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh! Forget it. I just wanted some courtesy!
Owen sneaks a glance at Spencer and Ben.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ahem. Not important. Cough.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Kindness!
Paige looks up at Owen, and her breath catches. He's unintentionally in that space that feels too close...
She leans forward...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are you...?
Before he can finish the thought, her lips are touching his...
Ben has failed.
Try again and see if you can help Ben get out of the house in time!

nodes.text: Suddenly, a strong wind blows through the cabin. The flames in the fireplace burst out then die, and the doors upstairs start slamming!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ahh!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's the gargoyle!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Run!
Everyone flees from the cabin!
Well, one thing's for certain...
Ben has failed.
That didn't end well at all! Try again and see if you can keep Ben calm this time!
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.
