menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: Ben panics and drops the gargoyle!
The gargoyle drops onto his foot with a loud crash!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Owwwwww!
Sam and Spencer scramble to get the gargoyle off Ben's foot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's too heavy without your help, Ben. Can you push while we pull?
They try again, but Ben's awkward angle keeps him from pushing the gargoyle off.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's not working.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What about slipping your foot out?
Ben uselessly tugs at his foot.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, I can't move it at all...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Okay, I know what to do.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sam and I are going to go back to the city to get some help. We'll be right back!
Spencer and Sam leap up and head for the exit!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait! You're not supposed to leave anyone behind!
But they keep running, oblivious to Ben's call. Ben stares at his trapped foot, trying to calm down.
All around him, the cabin seems to close in, and Ben finds it harder and harder to breathe.
Ben suddenly hears a low but insistent growl echo throughout the house.
When Ben looks up at the gargoyle, its ruby eyes shine, illuminating the room with red light the color of blood...
When Sam and Spencer come back twenty minutes later, there's no trace left of Ben... Or the gargoyle.
Inside, they slowly but surely move the gargoyle through the house.
They get a room's length away from the front door when they hear a loud 'thud' coming from somewhere behind them.
`Thud.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Thud.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What... What was that?
`Thud.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Thud.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know... But it sounded like a big footstep!
`Thud.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Thud.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spencer, quit it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's not me, man! I swear!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's coming closer! Let's move!
They move quickly across the room, and Ben feels his hands start to quiver. He fumbles with his grip on the statue.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If I don't calm down and focus, I'm going to drop the gargoyle...
The house seems to shake around them, and Ben feels the hairs on his neck stand up.
Howard punches Nate!
The blow makes Nate reel for a second...
Then he recovers, launching himself at Howard and pushing him back!
They burst through the doors of the gymnasium and straight into $ZOE's haunted house!
Nate and Howard barrel into a line of fake headstones and knock down the fake tree in the front!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no! My house!
Nate and Howard roll in the fake dirt, taking down fake cobwebs and strings of scary lights.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm. Taking. You. `Down!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm. Taking. You. [color=#e23b3b][i]Down![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Never!
Nate and Howard tussle for several more minutes until they're both suddenly drenched with punch!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What just happened?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Ugh! What did you do?!
They both look up to see $ZOE with a now empty punch bowl.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Stop it! Both of you!
Howard and Nate survey what they've done. The front yard of $ZOE's haunted house is a mess.
The tree has been completely uprooted, part of the house's facade has been ripped away, and the graveyard now lies in ruins.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's... It's ruined!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Zoe...
Howard stands up and puts an arm around her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm really sorry about what happened.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everything that Ben and I built... It's all ruined!
$ZOE breaks away from Howard and runs towards the girls' restroom.
Howard glares at Nate.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look what you've done!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I wasn't the only one rolling around in the graveyard, buddy.
At that moment, a police officer comes up to both of them.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You two! Stop right there!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We weren't moving...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: A likely story... You two are coming with me.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: My father is the `mayor`--
nodes.text_bbcode: My father is the [color=#e23b3b][i]mayor[/i][/color]--

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Your father could be a pig, but I'm still hauling you down to the station. Come on.
As Monte leads Howard and Nate out of the gym, Howard feels his stomach sink, knowing he's let $ZOE down...
One thing's for sure...
Howard has failed.

menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: Nate shoves Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You wanna go, man? I'll go! I could take you in a heartbeat!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You talk a big game... But you have `no` idea who you're messing with...
nodes.text_bbcode: You talk a big game... But you have [color=#e23b3b][i]no[/i][/color] idea who you're messing with...

nodes.text: Howard stares down Nate.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yeah, I do. I'm dealing with a washed-up, washed-out college guy who's pathetically trying to cling to the glory of his high school days.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Well, news flash: those days are `over.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, news flash: those days are [color=#e23b3b][i]over.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard is all at once filled with the overwhelming urge to punch Nate's face in.
Welcome to a new year of Surviving High School!

And now...
When we last left off, Owen and $ZOE were celebrating the football team's victory during the State Football Championships, and everything was going great!
Everything, that is, except for the return of $ZOE's ex-boyfriend Howard!
See what happens as Owen and $ZOE come to terms with Howard's return!

nodes.title: Howard's Return
nodes.subtitle: What happens now that Howard's back?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Owen.
That night, at Paige's plush after-party...
The football team stands in front of the Twin Branches students, their soda cans raised.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: A toast to us! We didn't just win any game...  We won the `State Championship!`
nodes.text_bbcode: A toast to us! We didn't just win any game...  We won the [color=#e23b3b][i]State Championship![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Woo!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: We wiped the floor with the San Adino Warriors!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Yeah! State Champs!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yeah! State Champs![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: We came, we played, we conquered!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `YEAH! SQUIRRELS FOREVER!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]YEAH! SQUIRRELS FOREVER![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer pushes Owen out in front and puts an arm around him.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And we have `Owen` to thank for scoring the winning touchdown!
nodes.text_bbcode: And we have [color=#e23b3b][i]Owen[/i][/color] to thank for scoring the winning touchdown!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Owen's the man with the plan! To Owen!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah! To Owen!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: `O-wen! O-wen!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]O-wen! O-wen![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: To Owen.
Everyone looks to Owen expectantly.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Speech! Speech! Speech!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... Thanks, guys! I couldn't have done it without...

nodes.prompt: I couldn't have done it without...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I couldn't have done it without...

nodes.text: At lunch, $ZOE walks out of her class, feeling deflated.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Owen... Hi.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You look down. What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor wants me to run a fundraising booth tomorrow, but I don't have any ideas...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've been thinking about it all morning...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I'm totally blanking! What would be fun for people? A disco ball? A pony show?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have to decide now if I'm going to have to buy supplies today!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't think a disco ball by itself in a booth is going to be much fun for people...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: See? Do you have any ideas?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know that sometimes if you get stuck, it helps listing as many ideas as you can.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why don't you try listing some activities that people find fun? Just throw out whatever you think of.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay! People enjoy...
Hey SHS Fans! Make sure you check out our NEW store under 'More Episodes!'

nodes.title: Swim Team Retreat, Part 1
nodes.subtitle: Can Emily handle drama with the girls?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Ben.
In Mr. Dean's English class, Mr. Dean stands at the front, holding a book.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: In `The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn,` what is it that keeps Huck and Jim together on the raft?
nodes.text_bbcode: In [color=#e23b3b][i]The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn,[/i][/color] what is it that keeps Huck and Jim together on the raft?

nodes.text: Ben's phone vibrates in his pocket. He sneaks a glance at it...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's a text from Emily!

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: bus leaving now! i'll miss u!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've `got` to see her one last time before she goes on this swim team retreat for the weekend!
nodes.text_bbcode: I've [color=#e23b3b][i]got[/i][/color] to see her one last time before she goes on this swim team retreat for the weekend!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Anyone?
Ben's hand shoots up!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Mr. Kale? What unexpected enthusiasm! You have an answer for me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Huck and Jim?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I really wish I'd read the book!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, Huck and Jim are kept together on the raft by...
Outside, both swim teams gather around Coach Kessler...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: All right, I bet all of you are itching to have a relaxing getaway weekend with your teammates.
Both teams let out hearty cheers!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Oh yeah, Coach K! And to eat as many hot dogs as possible!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I can't wait to swim in the lake!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! I love lake!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Sounds like you're very excited! Is that right?

nodes.speaker: Everyone
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Well `none` of that's going to happen!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well [color=#e23b3b][i]none[/i][/color] of that's going to happen!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh no. What are you doing now, Dad?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Not until you can all prove to me that you can function together `as a team!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not until you can all prove to me that you can function together [color=#e23b3b][i]as a team![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: But that's not fair! We've all set personal bests in our events!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And yet we are completely abysmal in the relay! I'm sick of watching us finish dead last every time!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: It isn't due to lack of talent. It's team dissonance, infighting, and complacency.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That's my fault! My responsibility! And it ends this weekend!
The swimmers groan, but one look from Emily's father silences them.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: For now, we're going to set up camp. We'll start by pairing up!
Emily's father randomly assigns everyone to a partner. When he reaches Sam...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Sam, you're with Emily! I want all of you working `with` your partners when setting up your tents!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam, you're with Emily! I want all of you working [color=#e23b3b][i]with[/i][/color] your partners when setting up your tents!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Well... What are you waiting for? Get to it!
A moment later, Emily and Sam are standing in a clear space, their disassembled tent lying on the dirt.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So... Should we start by hammering stakes through these corner loops?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You've got a lot of nerve.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I... I know you're angry with me about something.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I saw the look on your face back on the bus. Does this have something to do with...

nodes.prompt: Does this have something to do with...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Does this have something to do with...

nodes.text: Previously on `Surviving High School...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Previously on [b]Surviving High School...[/b]

nodes.text: On the way to a swim team retreat, Emily inadvertently made Hannah and Jane jealous by talking to Cameron.
They responded by abandoning Emily on the trail during a team-building hike to the top of Mount Collins!
Cameron came back for Emily, and the two of them headed for the mountaintop together. Along the way, Cameron promised to explain his odd behavior, but before he could...
They discovered that they were lost!

nodes.title: Swim Team Retreat, Part 2
nodes.subtitle: Will Emily and Cameron survive in the wild?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Emily.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I can't believe this... How'd we end up so lost?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Must have made a wrong turn. We want to be over there.
Cameron points to a peak off in the distance. Dark storm clouds gather at the top.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: That's probably where the rest of the team is.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Great...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hey, Em, don't worry.
He reaches over and tenderly moves a strand of hair out of her face.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: We're going to be okay.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey! What did I say about flirting with me?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: How is that flirting? All I did was move your hair.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, and all you did was sit next to me on the bus, `rescue me,` and then stare deeply into my eyes like you're some hot, weird, creeper!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, and all you did was sit next to me on the bus, [color=#3b78e2][i]rescue me,[/i][/color] and then stare deeply into my eyes like you're some hot, weird, creeper!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: So you think I'm hot?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Not funny. When are you going to tell me what's going on with you?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Later. Now's not the time. Right now, we need to head towards the summit.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Fine. You sure the team's there?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Based on when I last saw them, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And when was that?
You are now playing as Cameron.
Several hours ago...
Cameron is hiking up the trail toward the summit. Sam and Amanda are ahead of him, barely within earshot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're making pretty good time, don't you think, Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You can `make` time?!
nodes.text_bbcode: You can [color=#3b78e2][i]make[/i][/color] time?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I wish. If we could, I'd make it tomorrow.
Cameron glances behind him expectantly... But he doesn't see anyone.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: That's funny, I thought Hannah, Jane, and Emily were `right` behind me...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's funny, I thought Hannah, Jane, and Emily were [color=#e23b3b][i]right[/i][/color] behind me...

nodes.text: He turns and runs back down the trail...
After a moment, he spots Hannah and Jane hiking up.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hannah! Jane! Are you two okay?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah, we're fine now that you're here.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Don't be so forward, Hannah. You look pathetic.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Have you seen Emily?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Uhhhh...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: She `was` right behind us, but I thought she passed us.
nodes.text_bbcode: She [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] right behind us, but I thought she passed us.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You're sure she's not ahead of you? I just assumed since she kind of has that reputation for hanging around guys...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You know what I mean.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Actually, I have no idea what you mean.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Yeah, um, she's always giving off strong, flirtatious signals! You know, gawking or rubbing her face or pointing her elbows out like a chicken.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Uh, wow. That really explains your problems with guys.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Okay, maybe I don't know what flirting is!
You are now playing as Emily.
Back inside the tiny cave...
Emily and Cameron shiver as they try to start a fire.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Fun retreat.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Heh. I'd rather be doing laps against the resistance belt.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'd rather be listening to another lecture from Mr. Sanderson about the historical importance of wheat.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I think I'd draw the line there. Freezing in a cave with you is marginally better than a wheat lecture.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm flattered.
Cameron holds up two sticks.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: How is this supposed to work? These sticks are damp. I'm no science genius like your boyfriend, but you can't start a fire with wet things.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You just need some friction. Here.
Emily places the stick down so that the base of it is snug against the kindling she and Cameron gathered.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: All you have to do is rub the stick back and forth like this, you know, like you're making a snake out of clay.
Emily places the stick between her palms and starts rubbing back and forth...
You are now playing as Nate.
Late one night...
Nate walks into the school's library and finds Wes standing at the copy machine.
The light from the machine's scanner flashes, and Wes plucks a sheet from the machine's tray.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: What is that?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Side project. I have a few clients that want some assurance they'll pass Mr. Dean's mid-term on Friday.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Nothing to do with you...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Unless you're flunking English.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'd rather just get what I paid for.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Are you sure? The last time you asked me to get info on someone $ZOE liked, it didn't turn out so well for you.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I was just trying to protect her. $ZOE will see that eventually.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: So she hasn't talked to you since she found out you lied to her.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: So what makes you think it'll work this time?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: This time, she'll see that I'm the best guy for her. Now just tell me you have some dirt on Howard.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I did the standard search... And didn't get much. He's a straight arrow, that guy.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: No one's that clean.  There must be `something.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No one's that clean.  There must be [color=#e23b3b][i]something.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I'm sure there is, but it'll take a little more... `Incentive` to find it.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sure there is, but it'll take a little more... [color=#e23b3b][i]Incentive[/i][/color] to find it.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You ask too much.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Yeah, but someone has to. What are you going to do about it?
You are now playing as Nate.
Across town, Nate guides his car to a stop in an isolated parking lot.
Wes walks over.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Good to know you can follow directions...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm not your lackey. Tell me what I want to know.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: If you're looking for dirt on Howard... There isn't any.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: What I'm hearing is that `you messed up.` You don't have anything.
nodes.text_bbcode: What I'm hearing is that [color=#e23b3b][i]you messed up.[/i][/color] You don't have anything.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And you're supposed to be the best.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: What I `said` was that I didn't have any `dirt.`
nodes.text_bbcode: What I [color=#e23b3b][i]said[/i][/color] was that I didn't have any [color=#e23b3b][i]dirt.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: What do you have?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Well, how badly do you want to know?
Hey SHS Fans! `Sara and Nick: Novel Prelude` can now be found in More Episodes!

In the Storm, Nick and Sara enjoy several hour-long dates before tragedy strikes.
The Novel Preview provides a sneak peek at the first four chapters of the new `Surviving High School` novel, transformed into an SHS episode!
nodes.text_bbcode: The Novel Preview provides a sneak peek at the first four chapters of the new [b]Surviving High School[/b] novel, transformed into an SHS episode!

nodes.text: And in Getting Over Howard, $ZOE must handle the heartbreak of Howard being thousands of miles away! Check it out!
And now...

nodes.title: Psych Project, Subject: Owen
nodes.subtitle: Can Owen handle Paige observing his personal life?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Owen.
As he walks down the hall, he passes the cheerleaders, who are buzzing with excitement!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: OMG! Best day ever!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I'm so happy for her!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I knew this day would come. Totally called it! It does not get any smoother than my bro, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's everyone so excited for?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Howard and $ZOE got back together!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And for the record, not everyone is excited!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: She's `soooo` right. I'm more confused than excited!
nodes.text_bbcode: She's [color=#3b78e2][i]soooo[/i][/color] right. I'm more confused than excited!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Then how come you're so happy?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's Friday!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Or Thursday?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whatever... It doesn't matter! If it ends in 'day', I'm happy!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't argue with that. So, where `is` $ZOE?
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't argue with that. So, where [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Where do you think? She's probably off spit-swapping with Mr. Perfect right now...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Their faces all mashed up against each other like a couple of manatees.
Owen, thinking about $ZOE and Howard together, feels a rush of jealousy!
In the weight room... Owen carries weights from a rack and sets them on a barbell for bench pressing.
As he gets into position under the barbell, Paige hovers over him.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are you actually planning to spot me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I was just wondering if you were only planning to lift this much... Is it like a warm-up for when you lift more later?
Nearby, several of the guys from the football team snicker.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Ha ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Heh. Don't let him fool you! That's the most he's ever lifted!
Previously on `Surviving High School...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Previously on [b]Surviving High School...[/b]

nodes.text: Owen and Paige paired up for a school project in which Paige got a firsthand look at Owen's personal life!
At the end of the night, Owen tenderly expressed interest in learning about Paige, but Paige insulted him and stormed out, leaving nothing between them but bad blood.
And now...
You are now playing as Owen.
In the weight room before school starts, Owen prepares himself for a bench press set.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can do this! I can do this!
Spencer leans over him, prepared to spot him.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You ready yet, you flabby mass of lard?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This again? I thought you gave up on the whole angry assistant coach thing.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nah... Still trying. I think I have a real shot at getting the position if I can keep my grades up.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Er, I mean...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't talk back to me! I do the talking, tubby! Now lift!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Chill, Captain Mood Swing. I got enough of that from Paige last night.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I mean, everything was really cool between us, and then she just blew up at me.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Seriously, that chick is a headache with a fancy purse.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: My grandma thinks she was just protecting herself. Like she was feeling vulnerable or something.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No offense, bro, but your grandma's a little out of touch. I mean, she still reads `newspapers.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No offense, bro, but your grandma's a little out of touch. I mean, she still reads [color=#e23b3b][i]newspapers.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not sure who that discredits actually.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All I know is Paige treats you like dirt. Worse than dirt even! She treats you like... Like butt dirt!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Is that a thing?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Maybe?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She didn't mince any words, that's for sure.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude, you have to channel that anger! Lift man! Right now!
Owen thinks of all the insults Paige hurled at him and grabs the barbell.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Lift!
Owen pulls his truck through a gate in front of a large estate. He steps out, and a servant scurries around and drives his truck away.
Paige opens the front door.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Told you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Am I going to see my truck again?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Of course! Now get in before someone sees you out there.
Owen looks around the vast and empty estate.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Who's going to see me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Erg! Just come in!
Inside, Paige's home seems to shine from every angle. Fine china rests behind spot-free glass. Sparkling crystal chandeliers dangle delicately from the ceiling.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not your grandma's house, is it?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not at all.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, you're not going to steal anything, are you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What kind of question is that?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: A legitimate one!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I wasn't planning on it, but now I'm considering stealing the pump that inflates your ego!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever. Follow me. You finally have a chance to actually do something useful.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Because I'm totally useless otherwise?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Duh!
Paige leads Owen out to some stables. Several beautiful horses neigh playfully when Paige steps out.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You actually have horses!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Of course!
Paige walks over to a tall black horse. It bows its head, and she pets it behind its ears.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This is William. He's got a bad shoe, so I'm going to help him out a little bit.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And this is where you become useful! All I need you to do is pet him how he likes to be petted while I fix his shoe.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He's a softie, so don't worry about him biting you or anything.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just pet him behind the ears and keep him calm. A child could do it, so you've got good odds.
Before Owen can say anything else, Paige bends down and begins working on the horse's shoe.
Owen stares at the horse.
He reaches his hand out to pet the horse's ears... And the horse stirs.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen, keep him calm!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: There, there. Everything's okay...

nodes.title: The Halloween Dance, Part 1
nodes.subtitle: Can $ZOE beat Paige in this Social Chair showdown?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Ben.
It's the night before Halloween, and Ben, Emily, and their friends are in an abandoned house in the woods...
They sit in a semi-circle around a fireplace, the dim light from a low fire flickering across them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what are we doing here?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's kind of creepy...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's that point, Em! It's the night before Halloween! And you know what that means...
He pauses dramatically, but everyone stares at him blankly.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If Spencer were here, he'd know what I'm talking about. Where is he, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, Ben! What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm talking about scary ghost stories!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh! I have one! It's about `imaginary numbers.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ooh! I have one! It's about [color=#3b78e2][i]imaginary numbers.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The only one who thinks those are spooky is you, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But they could be anywhere!
Ben lights a flashlight and holds it up to his face.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I have a story... And it's one that took place in this very house!
Everyone quiets down as Ben weaves his tale.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This house wasn't always empty. A long time ago, a sculptor lived here with his wife and child.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This sculptor was very gifted. But the subjects of his work were always dark. He was obsessed with sculpting creatures of the `night.`
nodes.text_bbcode: This sculptor was very gifted. But the subjects of his work were always dark. He was obsessed with sculpting creatures of the [color=#e23b3b][i]night.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The fire crackles, and everyone sitting close to it jumps a little.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: One night, on a night just like this, he sculpted a gargoyle statue with bat wings and ruby eyes so real that it seemed it had flown right out of the underworld.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It terrified his wife, and she begged him to destroy the gargoyle, but when he tried, something strange happened... The gargoyle came alive right before his eyes!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no! Why'd it do that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Because...
$ZOE knocks on the door to Howard's house. She smiles when Howard answers.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hi, Howard! I'm really excited to see your parents again.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, listen... I need to warn you about something...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My parents were asking why I was in town, and I kind of told them--
Howard gets cut off when his father suddenly appears at the door beside him.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: $ZOE, you're here! Come and sit down. Dinner's on the table!
As Howard's dad herds $ZOE into the kitchen, she throws Howard a questioning look. He shrugs.
At the dinner table...
$ZOE sits down with Howard's parents and his sisters.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: It's nice to see you again, $ZOE. We enjoy having you around.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for inviting me over. I really missed you all.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Of course you did. And don't you ever think there's anything wrong with that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, no... There isn't.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We missed you too, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Did you bring us cupcakes?

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Cup cook? Cup cook?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, girls... I didn't.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Did you stop baking because you were sad?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sad?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Girls, you don't ask guests questions like that!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: But Howard said he came back because $ZOE was so sad that he'd left.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard said that?
She shoots Howard a look.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I may have mentioned that at some point...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't like Howard going away, but it had to happen.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: He said you were crying all the time!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not `all the time.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not [color=#3b78e2][i]all the time.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: $ZOE, it's all right. You don't have to talk about it.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Howard told us just how devastated you were. We're very concerned about you.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: How are you holding up, dear?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know why Howard told his parents all of that... But what should I say?

options.label: I feel better now that Howard's back.

nodes.text: You are now playing as $ZOE.
$ZOE walks alone through the graveyard beside a haunted house, passing by headstone after headstone.
Suddenly, Zoe hears a rustling behind her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's that? Who's there?
She backs up against the tall black gates surrounding the house.
She looks around, but all she sees is the gargoyle statue staring menacingly, its ruby eyes glistening in the night.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hello?
$ZOE moves closer towards the house...
And all at once, $ZOE sees movement in the corner of her eye!
A huge axe swings down on her!
$ZOE walks back to her side to find that her haunted house is still empty.
Sam, Howard, and Ben are nowhere to be seen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not even my closest friends are here... What now?
$ZOE sits on top of a headstone, trying to keep from tearing up.
You are now playing as Howard.
In the school cafeteria, Howard helps Mr. Russell collect cups and supplies for the dance's snack table.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Thanks for helping, Howard. It's nice to see a different face around here. It's usually just the same old staff.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's fine, Mr. Russell.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Please, it's Melville. Or Mel.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's fine, Mel. I'm actually enjoying myself. I didn't know that Ms. Pliny almost took the same major as me when she was in college.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Or that you and Alicia's sister got married!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Funny how it's not until after high school that you realize teachers have lives outside the classroom.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: I admit, I was surprised to see you around again. Aren't you supposed to be at Kingston?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm just on a break.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: That's good. You were always bright. When I heard you were majoring in the sciences, I was impressed.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: You'll be in an excellent position when you finish Kingston's program. It's the top rated in the country.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: But don't listen to me ramble on. Surely you must have something better to do then hang out back here on a Saturday night.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, my girlfriend's out there. I've been trying to see her all evening.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Ah. That must be it. I don't need you to set out more cups. You go out there and have fun.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's weird how I can talk with Mr. Russell like that. It's like we're equals or something...
Howard rushes towards the gym. Through the door's glass panel, he can see $ZOE sitting in front of her attraction, her head buried in her hands.
He is almost through the doors when...
Nate appears in front of him.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Where do you think you're going?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nate?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Listen, I don't want to hassle you, but technically, students aren't supposed to be back here.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Neither are recent high school graduates, but here you are.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. Here I am. Now can I get by?
Howard tries to step around, but Nate blocks his path.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you want, Nate?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: A faster car, a vacation house in Hawaii, and the chance to play football professionally...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: But what I want the most is for you to disappear.
Howard stares Nate down before responding.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know what it is you have against me, but I'm not the guy you should be trying to pick a fight with.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Am I? You're the all-star football player and seemingly good guy that swooped in to date the nicest girl in school...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Aren't you?
And then it clicks for Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I get what this is. You're taking your anger out on me because...

options.label: You hate being in my shadow.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It does? It's not because, you know, because you're interested in Cameron, is it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no. I'm done with guys for a while.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So then, why do you care if he talks to me?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well... On the last swim team trip, I think... Well, I heard he tried to make a move on Sara.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Emily! Sam! Hurry up over there!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know what Cameron's up to... But if it's his usual M.O., it seems really wrong.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I... I never knew that about him and Sara... He and Sara... They never... You know...?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No... I don't think so. I think they just talked a lot.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, if Cameron thought I was being standoffish before, wait until he sees me now.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good. So... You're okay?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah. Maybe a little stunned by the news, but I'm okay.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I just wish the other girls weren't so mad at me...
A few minutes later, all the tents have been assembled and the teams are once again huddled around Coach Kessler.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Good work on the tents. Now I want all of you to grab a new partner for the trust fall.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Trust fall?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Yeah, you kids don't know what a trust fall is? You stand in front of someone, fall backwards, and trust them to catch you.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Then they do the same for you.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: That sounds lame.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Besides, we `already` know who we can trust on this team!
nodes.text_bbcode: Besides, we [color=#3b78e2][i]already[/i][/color] know who we can trust on this team!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah, we know exactly who we can trust.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: It's not a request! Pair up!
Emily looks around for a partner, but can't find anyone. By the time everyone's paired up, she locks eyes with Hannah!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Looks like we're partners! Hey, Em, don't worry... I'll catch you.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That's what I like to hear, Hannah.
Emily's father walks toward another pair, out of earshot.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Or maybe not.
Emily stands with her back to Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm not interested in Cameron, Hannah! I have a boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Like that matters. Spare me, okay? I saw how the two of you were acting on the bus!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: He was just talking to me!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Are you going to fall or what?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hannah's not going to let me hurt myself, no matter how mad she is... Right?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: On the other hand, my dad will be a new level of furious if I refuse to participate!
Emily sighs, closes her eyes, and folds her arms over her body...

nodes.text: Why?

Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: But I didn't know if you were okay or not.
Emily blushes.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Wait... So, you didn't come back because you heard me yelling for you?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You were yelling?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Guess I'm not as loud as I thought.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I just came back because I was worried about you.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's actually... Really sweet of you.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hey, it was nothing a knight in shining armor wouldn't do.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You're wearing shorts.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: The `shining armor` of our generation.
nodes.text_bbcode: The [color=#e23b3b][i]shining armor[/i][/color] of our generation.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ha!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I guess that makes Hannah and Jane the evil witches...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I just can't believe they would abandon you like that!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's okay, Cameron.
Cameron turns just enough to raise an eyebrow at Emily.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: All right, it's not okay, but I don't want to think about it now. It's just going to make me angrier.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: That makes two of us.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm angry at you too, you know!
Cameron stops.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Me? Because you `thought` I was flirting with you! I told you I wasn't!
nodes.text_bbcode: Me? Because you [color=#e23b3b][i]thought[/i][/color] I was flirting with you! I told you I wasn't!

nodes.text: Lightning flashes across the sky! The clouds open up and rain begins to fall.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: It's sprinkling... For now. But it won't be long before it starts pouring. We should find shelter.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Or you could tell me this stupid thing you've been trying to tell me for the last day and a half!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: We're going to be in deep trouble if we get caught in heavy rain... Now is not the time.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Fine.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Okay, be mad, that's cool. Just stick close to me, okay?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, whatever. Just go.
Cameron turns and leads Emily up the side of the mountain.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: How do you know this is the way to go?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Because I'm an expert tracker. Before Twin Branches, I worked with my father as a fur trapper.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Too easy, Kessler. It's too easy with you.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I mean, come on, a fur trapper? Does that even exist anymore?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Har har. I'm `still` mad at you, you know.
nodes.text_bbcode: Har har. I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]still[/i][/color] mad at you, you know.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I know... I'm heading this way because we might be able to find some cover under these big boulders.
A few minutes later, the rain starts falling hard!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Aaah!` I'm getting soaked!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Me too! Come on! Follow me!
Cameron runs through the woods, Emily close behind.
As they round a corner, he stops!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So... I was in trouble, and you stopped to accuse Hannah and Jane?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You could look at it that way...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Or you could look at it another way... One that makes me look less like a jerk.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I don't know what way that it is.

nodes.text: Well...

Everyone chuckles...

nodes.text: But it will do. Everyone, bring it in.
The team gathers in around Emily and Cameron, squeezing them together in a group hug.

nodes.text: So... Do you guys want to stay for one more day? I promise... No more challenges. Just fun and relaxation!

It's time for you to sign up for your elective class. Write your name at the top, please. `Legibly.`
And then check the box next to the elective class you're most interested in.
Keith leans closer to $ZOE and whispers...
Even if you and Howard aren't together now, we all know you will be!
Yeah! We're really rooting for you! Especially since Howard is so hot!
You two are like perfect for each other! And Howard's amazing! All the stuff he's done for you!
Like--
Hey, $ZOE, sorry to interrupt...
Oh, it's okay, Owen!
I was just wondering... What elective are you going to sign up for?
Probably Finances. It sounds boring, but everyone always says it's a really fun class!
Yeah! I heard students actually make money!
That's my pick, but I'm doing it because I don't want to have to be in the same class as Paige.
How do you know what elective Paige is taking?
Please, someone like Paige would never take a Finances class. She's too stuck up to admit she needs to know anything about money.
She's probably taking something lame like Psychology.
Owen stares at the sign up sheet, his pen hovering over the box for Finances.
It'll be so great if we all take the same elective, because then you can give us `all` the details about you and Howard.
I bet the other cheerleaders will join too.
We'll be like a Howard and $ZOE gossip club!
Owen takes a deep breath, checks the box for Psychology, and passes his paper forward.
Looks like Owen's trying to distance himself from $ZOE... But what is $ZOE feeling about Howard?
Find out in the next episode of Surviving High School!

Back at Twin Branches...
Ben and Owen are walking down the hall toward the parking lot...
I don't know if you know this feeling...
But Emily comes back today! I want to kiss the first thing I see!
Uh...
Owen steps a little bit farther away from Ben.
I know the feeling. But it's been a while...
I'm guessing the flowers you're holding are for her?
Detective score up, Owen!
Heh.
So, what are you doing now that football's over with?
I've been asking myself the same question.
Every year at about this time, Spencer experiences this weird football withdrawal thing...
Last year, I caught him turning down a date with a cheerleader because he 'had to tackle something!'
Heh. When that happens, you've got it bad.
That's not even the worst part. The next day I saw him running across the field tackling a dummy he'd made out of paper mache.
He even named it. Football Face.
Wow.
So... No more football. What does Mystery Man do when he's not, you know, footballing?
Actually, I'm really looking forward to this Psychology class.
You're not taking Finances? It's supposed to be like the most entertaining class in the school.
Mrs. Fitzpootie let the cheerleaders turn the classroom into a club for their business project!
I heard it was a fun class, but I decided against it because... Well, I just did.
But... Cheerleader dance party... At school!
I have my reasons, okay?
Got it. Mystery man wants to keep the mystery. But just know... You're like the only person in Psych.
Not the `only` person.
Paige walks past the guys...
Not `all` the cool people are in Finances, Ben. Owen here made big strides last week, didn't you, Owen?
Stepped out from little Miss Croissant Hair's thumb--
Uh...
She means $ZOE.
Oh, I know. I'm just hungry now.
Owen here chose an elective she's not taking. You must really like her if you're avoiding her this much, huh?
Hey, I chose Psych because I'm interested in it.
Sure you are! Gotta go!
Paige sashays off.
If I had known she was going to torment me this much, I wouldn't have signed up.
Seems unfair, doesn't it? Like a French kid in the French class...
You've got a psycho in Psych class.
That was awful.
They reach the end of the hall, where they part ways.
Catch ya later. Try not to pass up any dates.
I don't know... Must. Tackle. Must. Tackle.
Owen walks away. Ben checks his phone.
Hmmm... No texts from Emily...
Ben steps outside...
...And sees that the bus has already arrived!
Ben runs down the steps, looking for Emily...
...But stops when he sees her and Cameron together!
Emily rests her head on Cameron's shoulder, and he puts his arm around her, giving her a playful squeeze!
He stares at the flowers in his hand, sighs, and walks toward Emily and Cameron...
What does this mean for Ben and Emily? Find out later in this season of Surviving High School!

The next day, Owen walks into his first Psychology class.
Not seeing anyone he knows, Owen sits down at the nearest desk and flips through his Psych textbook.
Maybe it's not the class I wanted, but it's better this way.
Who knows? Maybe I'll meet someone new...
And that's when Paige slips into the seat next to him.
If it isn't $ZOE's favorite boy toy!
Why are you sitting next to me?
It's a free country, isn't it?
Yeah, and I'm free to ignore you.
He turns away, but she continues to talk to him.
You know, I hear $ZOE and Howard are getting really serious now.
But I just don't know if it's good for her to go out with some college guy. Long distance never works out.
People are saying she's totally lost it.

It's good that you think that way.
The sooner you stop seeing yourself as $ZOE's lapdog, the sooner you'll realize you need to jump ship before it sinks.
What's that supposed to mean?
Social Chair. It's mine.
Yeah right.
Ask Taylor. I just got her unofficial endorsement.
And unlike $ZOE, I'm playing to win.
Owen starts to say something else, but then Mr. Dean walks through the door.
Welcome to Psychology 1. I'll be your teacher.
Part of psychology is delving into your own psyche. So we're going to start this year with a special assignment.
We're going to do class introductions. But you won't be responsible for your own.
Each of you will pair up with a random person from the class.
I'll explain the details of the project after I tell you who your partner is.
This project will be incredibly involved... Intensive... And deeply personal. Shall we begin?
Mr. Dean reads down the list of names until...
And Owen, your partner will be...
Paige!
What? Seriously?!
Looks like Owen and Paige have some rough times ahead of them!

That weekend, Emily and Ben are having lunch together...
So then Hector tells Miss Fitzpootie that the best way to make money is to throw the best party ever!
And what'd she say?
She said, 'There's always a better party.'
You should have seen the look on his face! It totally blew his mind!  It was like this...
Hee hee! That totally reminds me of this story that Cameron was telling me about at practice this week!
He--
Uh, hey, do you want a refill? I'm gonna get some more soda.
Oh, no thanks.
Ben gets up and refills his drink. When he sits back down...
So, how's Kimi doing?
Wait... I didn't get to tell you Cameron's story!
Oh, yeah. Right. Cameron.
So... We were just treading water together, and Cameron's talking about...
Hey, sorry to interrupt, but, um, what do you think of Miss Prez?
Alicia?
Sorry! Yes, Alicia.  I didn't know you were on a first name basis!
Yeah, well, once you mistake a teacher for a student, you enter into some really weird territory!
She seems cool.
I like her. I'm just glad I have her for homeroom and not for History. I heard she can be really tough!
But, wait, stop distracting me! I'm trying to tell you this story Cameron told me.
A look crosses Ben's face.
What?
I'm sorry, Em... I know you said you and Cameron are just friends and that nothing really happened on the trip, but...
I still feel jealous.
There's nothing for you to be jealous of!
I know. I hear that, but it doesn't change how I feel.
So... What do you want me to do?
I'm not going to ask you to stop talking to him. The last thing I want to be is `that` guy.
No, that guy sucks.
But can we just not talk about him?
Your answer for dealing with feelings of jealousy is to stop talking about the guy you're jealous of?
Pretty much. Yup. Out of sight, out of mind.
Only in this case, out of ear, out of mind...
And yeah, I know that came out weird, but I'm sticking to it.
Well... Okay, if that's what you want, I guess I'll stop talking about him.
That's what I want.
Now, about Kimi... How is she?
Um...
Emily tries to concentrate on talking about Kimi, but her mind dwells on what just transpired.
It feels weird that there's this whole part of my life I can't talk to Ben about now...

That night, Howard's parents are sitting at the dining room table when Howard comes in.
What's up?
We need to talk, son.
I'll make some tea.
Kay and Kel burst into the room.
Why aren't you two in bed where I left you?
Because 'we need to talk' is Dad code for 'you're in trouble!'
And if Howard's in trouble, we want to... Um... Offer our support!
You just want to watch me get in trouble.
That too!
Any member of this family under the age of sixteen may not be present for this meeting.
Aww! Phooey!
Wait! Kara's under sixteen! How come she gets to be here?
Kara coos from her crib in the corner.
Gaaaaa!
Uhhh... Anyone between the ages of three and sixteen may not be present for this meeting.
Unfair. Come on, Kel.
We just can't get a break in this house.
The girls leave.
They `are` right. About the Dad code. I'm guessing this is about me being home for so long.
We thought you were just homesick, son. And that was fine. But your mother and I discussed it, and we both think it's time for you to move on.
You mean, move on from $ZOE?
Horace and Cathy share a glance between each other.
You've been given an opportunity son. A scholarship that covers tuition we could never afford.
Just because it's expensive, doesn't mean it's valuable.
No, it doesn't. We know how much you care for $ZOE. We want you to be happy, and we both know how much the two of you love each other.
But your scholarship is for `a lot` of money!
Horace! Be sensitive.
I'm being sensitive, dear. I'm looking out for all the people who weren't offered scholarships to a prestigious university!
Guys, I `know` how much of an opportunity Kingston is for me, but...
Howard mulls over what he's about to say. He looks at his parents' faces and realizes he only has one course of action.
He sighs...
I didn't want to have to tell you this... But $ZOE was feeling really depressed without me.
Oh, dear.
Uh-huh.
She... She asked me to come back for a while. I couldn't say no.
Poor thing.
Well... I guess you can always make up some of the lost time...
I swear I will!
In the meantime, why don't we have $ZOE over for dinner sometime next week?
Uh... Okay. That sounds nice. Meeting adjourned?
For now...
Kay and Kel poke their heads in from the hallway.
Good meeting!
Yay! $ZOE's coming over!
Girls! What did I tell you?
Yah! Angry dad!
Run for safety!
As the girls rush back into their rooms, Horace laughs.
Ha! I can't stay mad at them!
That's because they're miniature versions of you, sweetie.
Meanwhile, Howard deals with the knowledge that he just lied to his parents!
What will this mean for Howard and $ZOE?! Find out in the next episode of Surviving High School!

$ZOE and Sam stand in front of the haunted house, waiting for people to show up.
So I didn't really get to talk to you until now. How was dinner with Howard's family?
His parents aren't happy that he wants to stay in Centerscore.
I'm not surprised.
Me neither.
Does this mean he'll go back to Kingston?
He's not sure yet. And I don't know if I want him to stay or go.
That sucks.
When we dated before... It was so easy. But now, it's never felt so hard for us to be together.
And I don't know what to do about that.
At that moment, Spencer comes up to them.
Hey... You two look bummed out. Want to dance?
What kind of pick-up line is that?
Not a pick-up line at all! It's just early, and I want to tear up the dance floor.
Is that so wrong?
I guess not. $ZOE, you coming?
I should stay here.
Sam and Spencer join their other friends on the dance floor between $ZOE and Paige's attractions.
$ZOE looks out over the crowd, wishing...
And that's when she feels a hand on her shoulder.
I hope it's not Nate...
She turns to find Howard standing behind her, holding a mask in his hand.
Howard!
Howard embraces her.
But how are you here?
It could be because I battled my way past security, burst through the doors, and snuck past the teachers...
Or maybe it's just because of this.
Howard holds up a badge with the words 'Parent Chaperone' on the front.
You're kidding.
Nope. Anyone can volunteer to chaperone the dance.
Which means you and I can enjoy the dance...
Together.

A while later, $ZOE wanders out of her haunted house.
Hey, $ZOE, where are you going?
I'm going to look for Owen. He dropped by earlier to talk to me, and I wanted to thank him.
All right. Have fun!
Of course!
$ZOE wanders into the hallway and sees Owen standing near a locker.
Hey--
She stops when she realizes he and Paige are talking. She ducks behind a corner.
What are you doing? Shouldn't you be out there celebrating or something?
I saw you come out here... I thought I should check on you.
I don't need your help.
...Right. So I'm just going to stand right here. Think of it as my job.
I thought your job was shining shoes or whatever.
Owen laughs.
Who polishes shoes these days?
Servants who have taste...
Which, come to think of it, means that `you` wouldn't be shining shoes.
There she is. The Paige we've all come to know and tolerate.
He playfully nudges her, and Paige flashes him a brief smile.
Hey, you want to get out and grab a coffee or something?
At some point, we should probably talk about... Well, you know, about `what happened` between us.
Don't you have a carnival to run?
Eh. I lost. I don't care anymore.
Owen looks wistfully at the doors leading back into the gym.
Hey, I get it. I know where you really want to be. Forget it.
She strides away towards the exit, and Owen follows her.
Wait up... I'll walk you to your car.
$ZOE presses herself deeper into the shadow of the lockers as they pass by her.
Owen... and Paige? I wonder what happened between them...
Looks like $ZOE's not the only girl in Owen's life anymore! How will she handle it?
Find out in the next season of Surviving High School!
And how did the other students enjoy the Halloween Dance? Let's check!
Owen... You have come to me in a state of confusion.
Well, kind of. I was actually looking for the restrooms...
And you arrived here. How am I wrong? Sit.
Okay.
Owen... There are big changes coming in your life. I see you before a crossroads, making a difficult decision. You must choose a path.
Which one?
The spirits warn you... They say you must `go left.`
Go left? Go left where?
It is not for me to see that. Remember their words.
So... Can I go now?
Poor soul... Nick, you are still troubled by the loss of a loved one.
Yes, I am. It's been... It's been hard.
But do not worry. You will be absolved, and the hardships you bear will lighten.
For now, do what you love, and love will come back to you.
I hope so.
Colt and Denni. A lovely pair. For you two... I see a sunset in your future...
A sunset's good isn't it?
No... In fact, doesn't a 'sunset' mean an end?
Okay, that doesn't sound good.
It's natural to be afraid or wary of a big change, but I also see a rising star for both of you.
You will be given the opportunity to rise again.
Awesome.
I confess, I'm a little skeptical about all of this. It's all a little vague.
Believe what you like. I know my fortunes will make sense in time.
Kimi... You have much ambition.
Ambition? Or an enthusiasm for popularity?
Whatever it is you call it... You have much of it, but it is tempered by a lack of direction.
This is about the after-school activities, huh? I swear, taking violin wouldn't have done me much in the long run.
So what's going to happen to me?
The spirits tell me that you should not worry. Your time in the spotlight will come...
Wes, welcome to my tent. I know you. You are clever and smart and can move those around you in ways they cannot even see...
You've got an accurate gauge so far.
The thing is... I know all about you... Madame Fortuna. Or should I say Myrtle Kazlowski?
Your cold readings are good enough to fool the chumps. But you're no psychic. So how'd you do it? Who's your `in` at the school?
My only `in` is the power I've been cursed with...
I said, you can drop the act--
Wes, my prediction for you is that you'll play a very important role later on... You will be the key to unraveling the entire mystery.
And you will do it out of love.
I'm not really looking for a girlfriend. It's easier to be unattached... But I look forward to seeing it come true. `If` it does.
Samantha... I see in your future a promising and blossoming romance this spring...
Now I `know` you're a fake... If you knew anything about my love life, you'd know there's nothing lucky there.
Do not take my words so lightly, dear. You have suffered, but the spirits beyond have something bright in store for you.
I'm going to need something more specific...
Sam swears she can see Madame Fortuna roll her eyes, but the fortune teller starts speaking.
I see a Friday between February 8 to 15. You will find a spark, and your life will change.
Uh, okay... I'll mark that down on my calendar.
Ben and Emily, welcome to Madame Fortuna's. What is it that you would like to know?
Ben and Emily exchange glances.
I think we want a general fortune about our future. As a couple.
Whoa, are you sure you want to know? What if she tells us that we're not meant to be together?
Then I suppose I'll have to leave you for someone else.
Aww...
Madame Fortuna sets out her cards and draws two of them out of the pile. Ben picks one, and the fortune teller turns it over to reveal a large boulder.
You are very compatible according to the cards, but there are things that stand in the way of you two being truly happy.
What are they?
I do not know the specifics, but the only way to remedy what ails your relationship acceptance of both yourself and each other.
Without full acceptance of one another, your relationship will suffer and end.
The fortune brings a pall to the room, and Ben and Emily uneasily slip outside the tent.
Do you think what she said will come true?
It wasn't really that specific. She just stated that we have to be honest and accepting of each other.
Haven't we been?
Ben thinks of all the times he and Emily have ever fought, and he suddenly thinks about everything related to Cameron.
No. And that's my fault. Madame Fortuna said that without full acceptance, our relationship will end.
I haven't been completely upfront about how I feel about Cameron.
I don't really like him, but if you trust him and he wants to protect you, then I guess hearing stories about him and talking to him sometimes is okay.
Really?
But don't expect that I won't make fun of him to his face.
Really? So Madame Fortuna actually changed your mind?
Yeah... Well, that and I can see Cameron making out with Jane by the Cursed Mummy Tomb.
Oh--
Emily turns to look.
--Oh!
Yep, and he just totally flashed me a thumbs up. Keep up the good work, buddy!
Emily kisses Ben on the cheek.
You're the best! Now can we go?
This is kind of like watching my older brother get his tonsils examined.
Emily takes Ben's hand and pulls him into the fake cemetery for a dance.
And that's your bonus scene!

nodes.speaker: Sam

A dialogue node's `side` is 'left' when the speaker is the current POV (the game shows the current main on the left) and 'right' otherwise.
